sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: At around 2am on Tuesday, March 19, 1985, 32-year-old David Brown got out of bed,
sentences.zh: 1985年3月19日星期二凌晨2点左右，32岁的大卫·布朗从床上起来，

sentences.en: put on some clothes, and then headed outside to his Honda Prelude, which was parked in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 穿好衣服，然后走到停在车道上的本田Prelude轿车旁。

sentences.en: David got into the car and backed out into Ocean Breeze Drive, the wide residential street in Garden Grove, Southern California, where he lived with his family.
sentences.zh: 大卫坐进车里，倒车驶入海洋微风大道。这是南加州加登格罗夫的一条宽阔住宅街道，他与家人就住在这里。

sentences.en: The mood at the Brown residence had been somewhat tense that evening.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，布朗家里的气氛有些紧张。

sentences.en: David's parents had come over to have dinner with David and his 23-year-old wife, Linda.
sentences.zh: 大卫的父母过来与大卫和他23岁的妻子琳达共进晚餐。

sentences.en: David and Linda had argued about how best to parent their 8-month-old daughter, Ashley, not her real name, as she had been crying a lot lately.
sentences.zh: 大卫和琳达因为如何更好地照顾他们8个月大的女儿阿什利（化名）而发生了争执，因为孩子最近总是哭闹。

sentences.en: David didn't think this was normal and he wanted Linda to rock Ashley to sleep to prevent her crying at bedtime.
sentences.zh: 大卫认为这不正常，他希望琳达能抱着阿什利哄她入睡，以防止她在睡觉时哭闹。

sentences.en: Linda wanted Ashley to learn how to self-soothe and said it would be fine to let her cry herself to sleep.
sentences.zh: 琳达则希望阿什利学会自我安抚，并表示让她哭累了自然入睡也没关系。

sentences.en: This had resulted in a quarrel between the couple.
sentences.zh: 这导致夫妻俩吵了一架。

sentences.en: When David asked his parents whether Ashley's crying was normal, they reassured him that it was and he subsequently apologised to Linda.
sentences.zh: 当大卫问父母阿什利的哭闹是否正常时，他们让他放心，说这是正常的，随后大卫向琳达道了歉。

sentences.en: That hadn't been the only unpleasant aspect of the evening.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是当晚唯一令人不快的事情。

sentences.en: David had a 14-year-old daughter named Cinnamon from a previous relationship who lived with him and Linda.
sentences.zh: 大卫与前任育有一个14岁的女儿，名叫辛纳蒙，她和他们住在一起。

sentences.en: Lately, Cinnamon had been butting heads with her stepmother and she'd been in a particularly bad mood that night, squabbling with Linda and being disobedient.
sentences.zh: 最近，辛纳蒙与继母的关系一直很僵，那天晚上她的心情格外糟糕，不仅与琳达争吵，还表现得很叛逆。

sentences.en: Cinnamon was off school that week for spring break and spending more time at home, which only heightened the tense atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙那周因春假没去学校，在家待的时间变长了，这让本就紧张的气氛更加紧绷。

sentences.en: To make matters even more difficult,
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，

sentences.en: Linda's 17-year-old sister, Patty Bailey, had also moved in with the young family.
sentences.zh: 琳达17岁的妹妹帕蒂·贝利也搬来和这个年轻家庭住在一起。

sentences.en: Their three-bedroom, ranch-style house didn't feel big enough to accommodate all the issues related to having a small infant and two teenagers living in the same space.
sentences.zh: 他们那栋三居室的牧场式住宅，对于要同时容纳一个婴儿和两个处于青春期的孩子所带来的种种问题来说，显得有些拥挤。

sentences.en: David, a successful man with his own computer business, was having trouble sleeping and decided to go for a late-night drive.
sentences.zh: 大卫是一位经营着自己电脑公司的成功人士，他当时正饱受失眠困扰，于是决定开车出去兜兜风。

sentences.en: First, he headed to a convenience store for a snack.
sentences.zh: 首先，他去了一家便利店买零食。

sentences.en: He bought a single-serve apple pie and a Dr Pepper soft drink, as well as four comic books.
sentences.zh: 他买了一个单人份的苹果派、一瓶胡椒博士汽水，还有四本漫画书。

sentences.en: David then headed back to the highway and drove aimlessly for a while.
sentences.zh: 随后，大卫回到高速公路上，漫无目的地开了一会儿车。

sentences.en: The roads were pleasantly quiet due to the lateness of the hour.
sentences.zh: 由于时间很晚，路面上非常安静，开起来很舒服。

sentences.en: Eventually, he turned onto Newport Boulevard and made his way to a Denny's chain restaurant to use the bathroom there.
sentences.zh: 最终，他转入纽波特大道，前往一家丹尼餐厅使用洗手间。

sentences.en: When he was done, David made his way back home.
sentences.zh: 办完事后，大卫开车回家。

sentences.en: He parked his car in the driveway, then quietly went inside.
sentences.zh: 他把车停在车道上，然后悄悄走进屋里。

sentences.en: As he walked into the living room, he was met by an alarming sight.
sentences.zh: 当他走进客厅时，眼前的一幕让他大惊失色。

sentences.en: His sister-in-law, Patty, stood there holding eight-month-old Ashley, trembling violently and sobbing loudly.
sentences.zh: 他的小姨子帕蒂正抱着8个月大的阿什利站在那里，身体剧烈颤抖，大声啜泣。

sentences.en: While David had been out, something terrible had happened.
sentences.zh: 在大卫外出期间，发生了一件可怕的事情。

sentences.en: At 3.25am, a call came through to a 911 dispatcher at the Garden Grove Police Department.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点25分，加登格罗夫警察局的911调度中心接到了一通电话。

sentences.en: A caller identifying himself as David Brown blurted out,
sentences.zh: 一名自称是大卫·布朗的报警人脱口而出，

sentences.en: He explained that he'd just returned home to find his wife's sister in a state of distress.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，他刚回到家，就发现妻子的妹妹处于极度惊恐的状态。

sentences.en: David said that Patty had been sleeping when all of a sudden she was startled awake by the sound of a firearm going off.
sentences.zh: 大卫说，帕蒂当时正在睡觉，突然被一声枪响惊醒。

sentences.en: 14-year-old Cinnamon had been standing at the foot of Patty's bed, holding a handgun.
sentences.zh: 14岁的辛纳蒙站在帕蒂床尾，手里拿着一把手枪。

sentences.en: She'd fired a single shot into the wall behind Patty's bed.
sentences.zh: 她对着帕蒂床后的墙壁开了一枪。

sentences.en: Cinnamon then left, and Patty heard two more shots fired from the direction of the main bedroom.
sentences.zh: 随后辛纳蒙离开了，帕蒂又听到主卧方向传来了两声枪响。

sentences.en: Baby Ashley cried out from her nursery, which sat between Patty's room and the main bedroom.
sentences.zh: 婴儿阿什利在位于帕蒂房间和主卧之间的育婴室里哭了起来。

sentences.en: Terrified, Patty said she raced into the nursery and scooped Ashley up before barricading the two of them in her room until she heard David return home.
sentences.zh: 惊恐万分的帕蒂说，她冲进育婴室抱起阿什利，然后把自己反锁在房间里，直到听到大卫回家。

sentences.en: She and David then briefly tried looking for Cinnamon, but there was no sign of her.
sentences.zh: 她和大卫随后简单地寻找了一下辛纳蒙，但没有发现她的踪影。

sentences.en: David told the 911 dispatcher he was worried she might have harmed her stepmother and herself.
sentences.zh: 大卫告诉911调度员，他担心她可能伤害了继母，也伤害了自己。

sentences.en: He'd glanced into his bedroom and noticed his wife lying in bed in an unnatural position.
sentences.zh: 他往卧室里瞥了一眼，发现妻子以一种不自然的姿势躺在床上。

sentences.en: He couldn't bring himself to go in and take a closer look, too scared of the grisly sight that might be waiting.
sentences.zh: 他不敢进去仔细查看，因为害怕看到那可能等待着他的恐怖景象。

sentences.en: Within minutes, a patrol officer arrived at the Brown residence.
sentences.zh: 几分钟内，一名巡警抵达了布朗家。

sentences.en: Ocean Breeze Drive was a pleasant, well-kept street in a nice part of town, home to professionals, middle-aged couples and young families.
sentences.zh: 海洋微风大道是镇上一处环境优美、维护良好的街道，住着专业人士、中年夫妇和年轻家庭。

sentences.en: It was the last place anyone would expect a murder.
sentences.zh: 这是任何人都不可能预料到会发生谋杀案的地方。

sentences.en: The officer was met at the front door by David, who was visibly distraught.
sentences.zh: 大卫在正门迎接了警察，他看起来明显心烦意乱。

sentences.en: I'm afraid to go in there and look, officer, he said in a shaky voice.
sentences.zh: “警官，我不敢进去看，”他声音颤抖地说道。

sentences.en: The officer headed through the living room and den towards the main bedroom.
sentences.zh: 警官穿过客厅和书房，走向主卧。

sentences.en: Its door was closed, so the officer pushed it open, shining his torch into the dark space ahead.
sentences.zh: 房门关着，警官推开门，用手电筒照向前方黑暗的空间。

sentences.en: Its beam landed on the bed, casting light across Linda Brown, who was lying on her back.
sentences.zh: 光束落在床上，照亮了仰卧着的琳达·布朗。

sentences.en: Her lower half was covered by a blue blanket, but her torso was visible.
sentences.zh: 她的下半身盖着一条蓝色毯子，但上半身露在外面。

sentences.en: Both her T-shirt and the sheets beneath her were soaked with blood.
sentences.zh: 她的T恤和身下的床单都被血浸透了。

sentences.en: Her right arm was extended, while her left hand was holding her left ear.
sentences.zh: 她的右臂伸展着，左手正捂着左耳。

sentences.en: Lying on the gold shag carpet next to the bed was a Smith & Wesson .38 calibre snubbed-nosed revolver.
sentences.zh: 床边的金色长毛地毯上躺着一把史密斯-韦森.38口径短管左轮手枪。

sentences.en: From the doorway, the police officer could hear Linda gurgling.
sentences.zh: 站在门口，警官能听到琳达喉咙里发出的咯咯声。

sentences.en: She was still alive.
sentences.zh: 她还活着。

sentences.en: Paramedics were urgently summoned.
sentences.zh: 急救人员被紧急召集过来。

sentences.en: They found that Linda still had a pulse, though it was weak.
sentences.zh: 他们发现琳达还有脉搏，虽然很微弱。

sentences.en: She also drew a short, shallow breath.
sentences.zh: 她还做了几次短促、浅显的呼吸。

sentences.en: Linda was transferred to the den, where paramedics administered CPR, then rushed her to the Fountain Valley Community Hospital.
sentences.zh: 琳达被转移到书房，急救人员在那里为她进行了心肺复苏，随后将她紧急送往芳泉谷社区医院。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, more police officers arrived at the property.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，更多的警察抵达了现场。

sentences.en: Some began to secure the crime scene, while others inspected the house.
sentences.zh: 一些人开始封锁犯罪现场，另一些人则对房屋进行了搜查。

sentences.en: Overall, the place was a mess.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，屋里一片狼藉。

sentences.en: Clothes and other objects were strewn throughout the residence, all of the rooms were cluttered, and waste paper baskets were overflowing.
sentences.zh: 衣服和其他物品散落在住宅各处，所有房间都杂乱无章，废纸篓也溢了出来。

sentences.en: A dresser had three of its drawers open, revealing various women's clothes, prescription pill bottles, and an empty gun holster.
sentences.zh: 一个梳妆台的三个抽屉敞开着，里面露出各种女装、处方药瓶和一个空的枪套。

sentences.en: Beneath Linda and David Brown's bed was a box of 12-gauge shotgun shells.
sentences.zh: 琳达和大卫·布朗的床下放着一盒12号口径的霰弹枪子弹。

sentences.en: There was a bathroom adjacent to the main bedroom.
sentences.zh: 主卧旁边有一个洗手间。

sentences.en: Police checked to see if Cinnamon was in there, possibly injured as well.
sentences.zh: 警察检查了辛纳蒙是否在里面，是否也受了伤。

sentences.en: But there was no sign of her.
sentences.zh: 但没有她的踪迹。

sentences.en: Other officers began to search the property's exterior in case Cinnamon was out there.
sentences.zh: 其他警官开始搜查房产外部，以防辛纳蒙在外面。

sentences.en: The front yard was entirely empty.
sentences.zh: 前院空无一人。

sentences.en: In the backyard was a garage, a trailer, and a secured kennel with two dog houses inside, home to the family's three dogs.
sentences.zh: 后院有一个车库、一辆拖车和一个带锁的狗舍，里面有两个狗屋，住着家里的三条狗。

sentences.en: But there was no sign of Cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 但没有辛纳蒙的踪影。

sentences.en: An officer radioed dispatch with the description of the missing girl.
sentences.zh: 一名警官通过无线电向调度中心报告了失踪女孩的特征。

sentences.en: Brown hair, brown eyes, short at a little over five feet tall, and weighing about 120 pounds.
sentences.zh: 棕色头发，棕色眼睛，身高刚过五英尺，体重约120磅。

sentences.en: A police helicopter was sent to Ocean Breeze Drive to see if Cinnamon could be spotted from above.
sentences.zh: 一架警用直升机被派往海洋微风大道，看看能否从空中发现辛纳蒙。

sentences.en: It hovered low over the houses, shining a spotlight into their yards.
sentences.zh: 它在房屋上方低空盘旋，用探照灯照向院子。

sentences.en: Police trawled the street on foot, using their flashlights to look for Cinnamon, and door-knocking neighbours to find out if they'd heard anything.
sentences.zh: 警察在街上徒步搜寻，用手电筒寻找辛纳蒙，并敲邻居的门询问他们是否听到了什么。

sentences.en: One man who lived directly across the street said he'd been woken by a loud thud at around 3.30am, but heard nothing further.
sentences.zh: 一位住在街对面的男子说，他在凌晨3点30分左右被一声巨响惊醒，但之后没再听到什么。

sentences.en: No one else reported hearing or seeing anything.
sentences.zh: 没有其他人报告听到或看到任何异常。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Linda Brown's sister, Paddy Bailey, began filling in the gaps via a police interview carried out at the house.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，琳达·布朗的妹妹帕蒂·贝利开始通过在屋内进行的警方访谈填补细节。

sentences.en: Paddy had moved in with Linda and David six years earlier, when she was 11.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂在六年前，也就是她11岁时，搬来和琳达与大卫一起住。

sentences.en: She'd been having some issues at home, and the newlyweds had welcomed her in.
sentences.zh: 她当时在家里遇到了一些问题，这对新婚夫妇收留了她。

sentences.en: David's daughter Cinnamon had only just moved in with them six months earlier, in September 1984.
sentences.zh: 大卫的女儿辛纳蒙是在六个月前，即1984年9月才搬来和他们住的。

sentences.en: Cinnamon hadn't been getting along with her mother, so moved in with her dad.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙和她母亲相处得不好，所以搬来和父亲住。

sentences.en: At first, everything seemed great.
sentences.zh: 起初，一切似乎都很美好。

sentences.en: Cinnamon adored her father, was content to share a bedroom with Paddy, and appeared excited to be a big sister to baby Ashley.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙很爱她的父亲，乐于与帕蒂共用一个卧室，看起来也很高兴能成为婴儿阿什利的姐姐。

sentences.en: She even helped Linda out with the baby where she could.
sentences.zh: 她甚至在力所能及的情况下帮琳达照顾孩子。

sentences.en: But Paddy said that within a few months, cracks began to show.
sentences.zh: 但帕蒂说，几个月后，裂痕开始显现。

sentences.en: Around Christmas, Cinnamon had become very moody and withdrawn.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节前后，辛纳蒙变得非常喜怒无常且孤僻。

sentences.en: She started arguing with her father and stepmother about household rules, and the chores she was expected to perform.
sentences.zh: 她开始因为家规和被要求做的家务与父亲和继母争吵。

sentences.en: Cinnamon seemed resentful of how much attention her infant sister received in comparison to her, and became increasingly rebellious and sarcastic.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙似乎对婴儿妹妹得到的关注远多于她而感到不满，变得越来越叛逆和刻薄。

sentences.en: Paddy recalled that a few weeks earlier, Linda had finally lost her patience.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂回忆说，几周前，琳达终于失去了耐心。

sentences.en: She requested that Cinnamon move out of the house and into a trailer they kept in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 她要求辛纳蒙搬出房子，住进他们放在后院的一辆拖车里。

sentences.en: Even though the trailer was properly furnished and had its own stereo and TV, this banishment only increased tensions.
sentences.zh: 尽管拖车装修齐全，还有自己的音响和电视，但这种“放逐”只会加剧紧张局势。

sentences.en: Cinnamon started dividing her time between the Brown residence and her mother's place again, and she blamed Linda for her increasingly unsettled situation.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙开始重新在布朗家和她母亲家之间往返，她把这种日益动荡的处境归咎于琳达。

sentences.en: When the officers asked Paddy for an account of that evening's events, she explained that David's parents had come over for dinner and to play cards, leaving at around 9.30pm.
sentences.zh: 当警察要求帕蒂讲述当晚发生的事情时，她解释说大卫的父母过来吃晚饭并打牌，大约在晚上9点30分离开。

sentences.en: After that, Linda had a shower and went to bed, while David, Paddy and Cinnamon had watched television in the living room.
sentences.zh: 之后，琳达洗了个澡就去睡觉了，而大卫、帕蒂和辛纳蒙在客厅看电视。

sentences.en: At one point, Linda got up for a drink and saw Cinnamon still up and sitting on the couch.
sentences.zh: 期间，琳达起来喝水，看到辛纳蒙还醒着，坐在沙发上。

sentences.en: She reminded the 14-year-old to go to bed, but Cinnamon ignored her.
sentences.zh: 她提醒这个14岁的孩子去睡觉，但辛纳蒙没理她。

sentences.en: At about 11pm, David went to bed, and Paddy and Cinnamon went to Paddy's room, where there was a trundle bed that Cinnamon often slept on.
sentences.zh: 大约晚上11点，大卫去睡觉了，帕蒂和辛纳蒙去了帕蒂的房间，那里有一张辛纳蒙经常睡的子母床。

sentences.en: As Paddy got ready to go to sleep, she couldn't shake the feeling that something was wrong with Cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 当帕蒂准备睡觉时，她总觉得辛纳蒙有些不对劲。

sentences.en: Paddy didn't know what it was, but she could sense that Cinnamon wanted to tell her something.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂不知道是什么原因，但她能感觉到辛纳蒙想告诉她什么。

sentences.en: Paddy offered to stay up a bit longer and watch MTV, an offer Cinnamon accepted.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂主动提出再多待一会儿看MTV，辛纳蒙接受了这个提议。

sentences.en: As they sat together in front of the television,
sentences.zh: 当她们一起坐在电视机前时，

sentences.en: Paddy said she'd try to encourage Cinnamon to open up, to no avail.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂说她试图鼓励辛纳蒙敞开心扉，但无济于事。

sentences.en: Eventually, Paddy decided to go to bed.
sentences.zh: 最终，帕蒂决定去睡觉。

sentences.en: A few minutes after she went to her room,
sentences.zh: 在她回房间几分钟后，

sentences.en: Cinnamon followed.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙跟了过来。

sentences.en: She asked Paddy to explain something to her before going to sleep.
sentences.zh: 她在睡觉前问了帕蒂一个问题。

sentences.en: Cinnamon then revealed she was carrying a small handgun and asked,
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙随后透露她带着一把小手枪，并问道：

sentences.en: How do you work this?
sentences.zh: “这个怎么用？”

sentences.en: Paddy asked why.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂问为什么。

sentences.en: Just in case, Cinnamon replied.
sentences.zh: “以防万一，”辛纳蒙回答。

sentences.en: When Paddy asked, In case of what?
sentences.zh: 当帕蒂问：“以防什么？”

sentences.en: Cinnamon stated, In case someone breaks in.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙说：“以防有人闯进来。”

sentences.en: Paddy tried to reassure the girl that their home's alarm system would prevent intruders, but Cinnamon was adamant that she wanted to know what to do in case of an emergency.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂试图让女孩放心，说家里的警报系统会阻止入侵者，但辛纳蒙坚持要学会如何在紧急情况下使用它。

sentences.en: Paddy eventually told her,
sentences.zh: 帕蒂最终告诉她：

sentences.en: I'm not positive.
sentences.zh: “我也不太确定。”

sentences.en: I've just seen this on TV.
sentences.zh: “我只是在电视上看到过。”

sentences.en: You just cock it back and pull the trigger.
sentences.zh: “你只要把击锤向后扳，然后扣动扳机就行了。”

sentences.en: Cinnamon thanked Paddy and left.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙道了谢，然后离开了。

sentences.en: Then Paddy went to sleep.
sentences.zh: 接着帕蒂就睡着了。

sentences.en: The next thing she knew, she was being woken up by Cinnamon firing a single shot into the wall of her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 她醒来时，是因为辛纳蒙对着她卧室的墙壁开了一枪。

sentences.en: David Brown gave a similar account of the evening's events, though he explained that he hadn't been home when the shooting unfolded.
sentences.zh: 大卫·布朗对当晚事件的描述与此类似，但他解释说枪击发生时他并不在家。

sentences.en: After going to bed beside his already sleeping wife, he'd read a few comic books but struggled to doze off.
sentences.zh: 在已经睡着的妻子身边躺下后，他读了几本漫画书，但很难入睡。

sentences.en: His mind troubled and racing due to the recent discord in his home, he'd decided to go for a drive to clear his head.
sentences.zh: 由于家里最近的不和，他心烦意乱，思绪万千，于是决定开车出去散散心。

sentences.en: He'd described how when he returned home more than an hour later, he'd found a distraught Paddy holding his baby.
sentences.zh: 他描述说，一个多小时后他回到家，发现心烦意乱的帕蒂抱着他的孩子。

sentences.en: Paddy told him what had happened before going out to the backyard to look for Cinnamon, checking in the trailer where she usually slept.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂告诉他发生了什么事，然后去后院寻找辛纳蒙，检查了她通常睡觉的拖车。

sentences.en: But Cinnamon had vanished.
sentences.zh: 但辛纳蒙已经消失了。

sentences.en: While Paddy looked for Cinnamon,
sentences.zh: 当帕蒂寻找辛纳蒙时，

sentences.en: David called his parents in a state of shock.
sentences.zh: 大卫在震惊中给父母打了电话。

sentences.en: They told him to call the police, and that's when he phoned 911.
sentences.zh: 他们让他报警，于是他拨打了911。

sentences.en: David told officers that the family owned eight rifles as well as two handguns that were always loaded.
sentences.zh: 大卫告诉警察，家里有八支步枪和两支总是上膛的手枪。

sentences.en: While some of the firearms were kept in a safe, he kept his blue steel revolver wrapped in a Kmart shopping bag in the bottom drawer of his nightstand.
sentences.zh: 虽然有些枪支存放在保险箱里，但他把那把蓝钢左轮手枪用凯马特购物袋包着，放在床头柜的底层抽屉里。

sentences.en: The other handgun belonged to Linda, and David said he didn't know where she kept it.
sentences.zh: 另一把手枪是琳达的，大卫说他不知道她把它放在哪里。

sentences.en: Gunshot residue tests were carried out on Paddy and David to see if either of them could have fired the weapon.
sentences.zh: 警方对帕蒂和大卫进行了枪击残留物测试，以确定他们中是否有人开过枪。

sentences.en: Both tests came back negative.
sentences.zh: 两项测试结果均为阴性。

sentences.en: David was visibly distraught, shaking and chain-smoking as he spoke with the police.
sentences.zh: 大卫在与警察交谈时明显心烦意乱，浑身发抖，一根接一根地抽烟。

sentences.en: His parents soon arrived at the residence and took baby Ashley into their care.
sentences.zh: 他的父母很快赶到住所，接手照顾婴儿阿什利。

sentences.en: At 4.26am, almost exactly an hour after David first called 911, a call came through from the hospital.
sentences.zh: 凌晨4点26分，距离大卫第一次拨打911几乎正好过去了一个小时，医院打来了一通电话。

sentences.en: Linda Brown had died.
sentences.zh: 琳达·布朗去世了。

sentences.en: The case was now a murder investigation, and the suspect was still missing.
sentences.zh: 案件现在升级为谋杀调查，而嫌疑人仍然下落不明。

sentences.en: By 6am, daylight was beginning to break.
sentences.zh: 到了早上6点，天开始亮了。

sentences.en: During a search of Cinnamon's trailer, police officers had found a small Dachshund puppy, which belonged to the 14-year-old.
sentences.zh: 在搜查辛纳蒙的拖车时，警官发现了一只属于这名14岁女孩的小腊肠犬。

sentences.en: They decided to place it in the kennel in the backyard, where the family's other dogs, two Cocker Spaniels and a Pomeranian, were kept.
sentences.zh: 他们决定把它安置在后院的狗舍里，那里还关着家里的另外两只可卡犬和一只博美犬。

sentences.en: Detective Fred McLean and two other officers entered the kennel and set the puppy down.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·麦克林警探和另外两名警官走进狗舍，把小狗放了下来。

sentences.en: As they did so,
sentences.zh: 就在这时，

sentences.en: Detective McLean noticed something poking out of one of the two doghouses that sat at the back of the pen.
sentences.zh: 麦克林警探注意到围栏后方的两个狗屋里，有什么东西露了出来。

sentences.en: It was a white tennis shoe.
sentences.zh: 那是一只白色的网球鞋。

sentences.en: Detective McLean walked towards the doghouse and bent down.
sentences.zh: 麦克林警探朝狗屋走去，弯下腰。

sentences.en: Peering inside, he saw a small figure curled up in the fetal position.
sentences.zh: 他往里一瞧，看到一个蜷缩成胎儿姿势的小身影。

sentences.en: It was a young girl whose long brown hair had fallen across her face.
sentences.zh: 那是一个年轻女孩，棕色的长发垂在脸上。

sentences.en: Cinnamon, Detective McLean called.
sentences.zh: “辛纳蒙？”麦克林警探喊道。

sentences.en: The girl muttered unintelligibly in response.
sentences.zh: 女孩含糊不清地嘟囔着作为回应。

sentences.en: The detective reached inside the doghouse and took Cinnamon's hand in his, pulling her up and out of the small space.
sentences.zh: 警探伸手进狗屋，握住辛纳蒙的手，将她从狭小的空间里拉了出来。

sentences.en: She wore a sweatshirt and pants, which were covered with what looked to be bright red vomit.
sentences.zh: 她穿着运动衫和裤子，上面沾满了看起来像是鲜红色的呕吐物。

sentences.en: Vomit also coated the floor of the doghouse Cinnamon had been lying on, dotted with what looked to be pill capsules.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙躺着的狗屋地板上也满是呕吐物，还散落着看起来像是药囊的东西。

sentences.en: The smell of urine permeated the air.
sentences.zh: 空气中弥漫着尿骚味。

sentences.en: Cinnamon's hair was dishevelled, she was shaking and appeared barely conscious.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙头发凌乱，浑身发抖，看起来意识模糊。

sentences.en: Clutched in one of her hands was a piece of pink cardboard paper wrapped with a red ribbon.
sentences.zh: 她手里紧紧攥着一张用红丝带缠绕的粉色硬纸片。

sentences.en: Detective McLean took the paper from Cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 麦克林警探从辛纳蒙手中拿走了纸片。

sentences.en: Written on it in messy, childlike handwriting were the words,
sentences.zh: 上面用稚嫩且凌乱的笔迹写着：

sentences.en: Dear God, please forgive me.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的上帝，请原谅我。

sentences.en: I didn't mean to hurt her.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意要伤害她的。

sentences.en: Detective McLean guided Cinnamon into a waiting police car to be driven to the station.
sentences.zh: 麦克林警探带着辛纳蒙坐上等候的警车，准备前往警局。

sentences.en: On the way,
sentences.zh: 在路上，

sentences.en: Cinnamon asked the two officers accompanying her if her father was alright.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙问陪同她的两名警官，她的父亲是否安好。

sentences.en: They told her he was.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉她，他没事。

sentences.en: Is Paddy alright?
sentences.zh: “帕蒂还好吗？”

sentences.en: Cinnamon asked.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙问道。

sentences.en: Yes, they answered.
sentences.zh: “是的，”他们回答。

sentences.en: How about Linda?
sentences.zh: “琳达呢？”

sentences.en: Cinnamon said.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙说。

sentences.en: How's Linda?
sentences.zh: “琳达怎么样了？”

sentences.en: The two officers didn't reply.
sentences.zh: 两名警官没有回答。

sentences.en: When they reached the police station,
sentences.zh: 当他们到达警察局时，

sentences.en: Cinnamon was photographed, underwent a gunshot residue test and was checked by paramedics.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙接受了拍照、枪击残留物测试，并由医护人员进行了检查。

sentences.en: Still as groggy as she'd appeared at home,
sentences.zh: 她依然像在家时那样昏昏沉沉，

sentences.en: Cinnamon drifted between lucidity and unconsciousness.
sentences.zh: 意识在清醒与昏迷之间徘徊。

sentences.en: It appeared that she was either intoxicated or under the influence of a drug.
sentences.zh: 看起来她要么是喝醉了，要么是受到了药物影响。

sentences.en: Her blood pressure was low, but she wasn't in any danger and could still answer questions.
sentences.zh: 她的血压很低，但没有生命危险，仍然可以回答问题。

sentences.en: At 8am,
sentences.zh: 早上8点，

sentences.en: Cinnamon Brown was interviewed by Detective McLean.
sentences.zh: 麦克林警探对辛纳蒙·布朗进行了审讯。

sentences.en: Do you know why you're here?
sentences.zh: “你知道你为什么在这里吗？”

sentences.en: Detective McLean asked.
sentences.zh: 麦克林警探问道。

sentences.en: Because I hurt Linda,
sentences.zh: “因为我伤害了琳达，”

sentences.en: Cinnamon replied.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙回答。

sentences.en: How did you hurt Linda?
sentences.zh: “你是怎么伤害琳达的？”

sentences.en: He asked.
sentences.zh: 他问道。

sentences.en: I shot her, came the response.
sentences.zh: “我开枪打死了她，”她回答道。

sentences.en: Detective McLean informed the teenager that Linda was dead and then read Cinnamon her rights.
sentences.zh: 麦克林警探告知这名少女琳达已经死亡，随后宣读了她的权利。

sentences.en: While Cinnamon said that she felt sick, she agreed that she understood her rights and would proceed with questioning.
sentences.zh: 虽然辛纳蒙说她感到恶心，但她表示理解自己的权利，并同意继续接受审讯。

sentences.en: She told Detective McLean that she'd moved out of her mother's home because her mother yelled too much and it made her nervous.
sentences.zh: 她告诉麦克林警探，她搬出母亲家是因为母亲总是大吼大叫，让她感到紧张。

sentences.en: Cinnamon got along well with her father so she'd thought living with him would be better.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙和父亲相处得很好，所以她认为和父亲住在一起会更好。

sentences.en: But she and Linda soon began to clash.
sentences.zh: 但她和琳达很快就开始发生冲突。

sentences.en: Cinnamon said she disapproved of Linda's parenting, especially her use of a self-soothing method for the baby, which Cinnamon saw as neglectful.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙说她不赞同琳达的育儿方式，尤其是琳达对婴儿使用的自我安抚法，辛纳蒙认为那是疏于照顾。

sentences.en: She also accused Linda of sometimes hitting her baby, which angered Cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 她还指责琳达有时会打孩子，这让辛纳蒙感到愤怒。

sentences.en: She said that Linda was tired of her and didn't like her, adding that Linda had said she no longer wanted Cinnamon in the house so she'd moved out to the trailer in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 她说琳达厌倦了她，不喜欢她，并补充说琳达曾表示不想再让她住在家里，所以她搬到了后院的拖车里。

sentences.en: But that hadn't resolved matters.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有解决问题。

sentences.en: Cinnamon said that the previous evening she and Linda had had a big fight.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙说前一天晚上她和琳达大吵了一架。

sentences.en: She told me that she hated my guts and I go, I guess I hate you too,
sentences.zh: “她告诉我她恨透了我，我说，我想我也恨你，”

sentences.en: Cinnamon recalled.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙回忆道。

sentences.en: Detective McLean asked if Linda had said why she hated her.
sentences.zh: 麦克林警探问琳达是否说了为什么恨她。

sentences.en: No, Cinnamon replied.
sentences.zh: “没有，”辛纳蒙回答。

sentences.en: She wouldn't tell me.
sentences.zh: “她不肯告诉我。”

sentences.en: Cinnamon believed Linda was jealous of her close bond with David,
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙认为琳达嫉妒她与大卫之间的亲密关系，

sentences.en: adding,
sentences.zh: 并补充道：

sentences.en: I'm my daddy's daughter.
sentences.zh: “我是我爸爸的女儿。”

sentences.en: Though she struggled at points to answer the questions,
sentences.zh: 尽管有时难以回答问题，

sentences.en: Cinnamon managed to continue.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙还是设法继续说了下去。

sentences.en: She said that the previous night's argument had culminated in Linda threatening to kill Cinnamon if she hadn't left the house by the time Linda woke up the following morning.
sentences.zh: 她说前一天晚上的争吵最终以琳达的威胁告终，琳达威胁说如果第二天早上她醒来时辛纳蒙还没离开，就杀了她。

sentences.en: Detective McLean asked Cinnamon whose gun she had used to shoot Linda.
sentences.zh: 麦克林警探问辛纳蒙是用谁的枪射杀琳达的。

sentences.en: Cinnamon said it was her father's and that she'd found it in an office drawer, explaining,
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙说是她父亲的，她在办公室抽屉里找到的，并解释道：

sentences.en: I shot three shots.
sentences.zh: “我开了三枪。”

sentences.en: One of them was in my room with Patty and the other two were with Linda.
sentences.zh: “其中一枪是在我房间里对着帕蒂开的，另外两枪是对着琳达开的。”

sentences.en: Cinnamon hadn't planned to shoot Patty.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙本没打算射击帕蒂。

sentences.en: That shot had only gone off due to Cinnamon trying to figure out how to operate the weapon.
sentences.zh: 那一枪走火纯粹是因为辛纳蒙在研究如何操作武器。

sentences.en: She said that no one had shown her how to use the revolver, but she'd had some experience firing little guns before.
sentences.zh: 她说没有人教过她如何使用这把左轮手枪，但她以前有过操作小枪的经验。

sentences.en: As the interview went on,
sentences.zh: 随着审讯的进行，

sentences.en: Cinnamon became increasingly drowsy and her speech slowed with each answer.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙变得越来越困倦，回答问题的语速也越来越慢。

sentences.en: At one point, she murmured under her breath,
sentences.zh: 有一次，她低声嘟囔道：

sentences.en: Please don't let them get away with murder.
sentences.zh: “请别让他们逍遥法外。”

sentences.en: When Detective McLean reminded her that she had to answer his questions to ensure she didn't get away with it,
sentences.zh: 当麦克林警探提醒她，她必须回答他的问题以确保她自己不会逍遥法外时，

sentences.en: Cinnamon replied in a dazed voice,
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙神志不清地回答：

sentences.en: I'm trying to, but I can't keep my eyes open.
sentences.zh: “我在努力，但我睁不开眼睛。”

sentences.en: Realising Cinnamon was on the verge of passing out,
sentences.zh: 意识到辛纳蒙即将昏厥，

sentences.en: McLean ended the interview after just 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 麦克林在仅仅30分钟后就结束了审讯。

sentences.en: By this stage, she could barely hold her head up.
sentences.zh: 此时，她几乎连头都抬不起来了。

sentences.en: Just as they were about to leave the interrogation room,
sentences.zh: 就在他们准备离开审讯室时，

sentences.en: Cinnamon explained why she was so tired.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙解释了她为什么这么累。

sentences.en: Earlier that morning, she'd taken about 80 capsules of some kind of drug.
sentences.zh: 当天早些时候，她服用了大约80粒某种药物。

sentences.en: Testing revealed that she'd taken a massive overdose of Darvacet, a prescription painkiller, and diazide, a diuretic used to treat high blood pressure.
sentences.zh: 检测显示，她过量服用了大量的达尔伏塞特（一种处方止痛药）和地阿齐德（一种用于治疗高血压的利尿剂）。

sentences.en: Cinnamon was admitted to the Garden Grove
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙被送往花园格罗夫

sentences.en: Medical Centre for treatment.
sentences.zh: 医疗中心接受治疗。

sentences.en: After arriving at the hospital,
sentences.zh: 到达医院后，

sentences.en: Cinnamon told another police officer there how she'd shot Linda, before falling asleep.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙在昏睡过去之前，又向那里的另一名警官讲述了她是如何射杀琳达的。

sentences.en: She was subsequently transferred to the jail ward of another hospital where she confessed twice more to a physician and a psychiatriSt.
sentences.zh: 随后她被转送到另一家医院的监狱病房，在那里她又向一名内科医生和一名精神科医生各坦白了一次。

sentences.en: Cinnamon was monitored carefully over the following days.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天里，辛纳蒙受到了严密的监视。

sentences.en: All up, she had consumed three bottles of prescription medication that had belonged to her father and it was a miracle she had survived.
sentences.zh: 总共算下来，她服用了三瓶属于她父亲的处方药，能活下来简直是个奇迹。

sentences.en: The dose she'd taken contained more than six times the fatal amount of propoxipine, an opioid and a key ingredient in Darvacet.
sentences.zh: 她服用的剂量中，丙氧芬（一种阿片类药物，也是达尔伏塞特的主要成分）的含量超过了致死量的六倍。

sentences.en: During an interview with the police,
sentences.zh: 在接受警方采访时，

sentences.en: Cinnamon's father,
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙的父亲，

sentences.en: David Brown, said this was not the first time his daughter had self-harmed.
sentences.zh: 大卫·布朗说，这已经不是他女儿第一次自残了。

sentences.en: Just two weeks earlier, she had overdosed on aspirin.
sentences.zh: 就在两周前，她还曾服用过量阿司匹林。

sentences.en: David said he blamed himself for Linda's murder because he hadn't realised how deeply troubled Cinnamon was and he therefore hadn't encouraged her to seek therapy sooner.
sentences.zh: 大卫说他责怪自己导致了琳达的谋杀案，因为他没有意识到辛纳蒙的精神问题有多严重，因此没能尽早鼓励她寻求心理治疗。

sentences.en: He said he'd forgotten to set the house alarm before his late-night drive.
sentences.zh: 他说他在深夜开车出门前忘记设置家里的警报系统了。

sentences.en: Had he done so,
sentences.zh: 如果他设置了，

sentences.en: Cinnamon might have triggered it and Linda might still be alive.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙可能会触发警报，琳达或许还能活着。

sentences.en: Regardless of
sentences.zh: 无论

sentences.en: Cinnamon's actions,
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙的行为如何，

sentences.en: David vowed to stand by his daughter, insisting she needed him now more than ever.
sentences.zh: 大卫发誓要支持他的女儿，坚称她现在比以往任何时候都更需要他。

sentences.zh: 弗雷德·麦克莱恩侦探耳中，他们是曾负责

sentences.en: Linda Brown's case.
sentences.zh: 琳达·布朗案件的调查人员。

sentences.en: Although Linda's murder had technically been solved,
sentences.zh: 尽管琳达的谋杀案从技术上讲已经结案，

sentences.en: Newell and McLean had been unable to shake the unsettling feeling that the story was incomplete.
sentences.zh: 但纽厄尔和麦克莱恩一直无法摆脱一种不安的感觉，即这个故事并不完整。

sentences.en: There were some curious aspects to the crime that had left them scratching their heads, despite its seemingly clear-cut nature.
sentences.zh: 这起犯罪中存在一些令人好奇的细节，尽管案件看起来一目了然，但这些细节让他们感到困惑。

sentences.en: For starters, David's actions in the wake of his wife's murder had been odd.
sentences.zh: 首先，大卫在妻子被杀后的行为就很奇怪。

sentences.en: After returning home to find
sentences.zh: 回到家发现

sentences.en: Patty Bailey distraught and talking about gunshots,
sentences.zh: 帕蒂·贝利心烦意乱地谈论枪声后，

sentences.en: David had refused to even enter the bedroom to check on Linda.
sentences.zh: 大卫甚至拒绝进入卧室查看琳达的情况。

sentences.en: He'd called his father before calling 911 and told first responders he was too afraid to see Linda.
sentences.zh: 他在拨打911之前先给父亲打了电话，并告诉急救人员他太害怕了，不敢看琳达。

sentences.en: This behaviour was at odds with the way family members of victims typically responded, by rushing to check on their loved one and administer first aid.
sentences.zh: 这种行为与受害者家属通常的反应截然不同，他们通常会冲过去查看亲人的情况并进行急救。

sentences.en: When police had interviewed
sentences.zh: 当警方在

sentences.en: David in the aftermath of
sentences.zh: 琳达被杀后采访

sentences.en: Linda's murder, he'd made some emotional outbursts and seemed more concerned with complaining to detectives about having a bad headache.
sentences.zh: 大卫时，他情绪激动，似乎更关心向侦探抱怨自己头痛得厉害。

sentences.en: David had told detectives that earlier that night after going to bed, he and Linda had sex.
sentences.zh: 大卫告诉侦探，那天晚上早些时候上床睡觉后，他和琳达发生了性关系。

sentences.en: Yet, her autopsy revealed no evidence that she'd recently had intercourse.
sentences.zh: 然而，尸检显示她最近并没有发生过性行为。

sentences.en: David had also mentioned how he'd asked Patty to go out in the backyard to look for cinnamon when he first arrived home.
sentences.zh: 大卫还提到，他刚到家时曾让帕蒂去后院寻找辛纳蒙。

sentences.en: This struck detectives as bizarre.
sentences.zh: 这让侦探们觉得很离奇。

sentences.en: At the time, Cinnamon had been a potentially armed fugitive who'd just killed her stepmother and fired a shot into Patty's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 当时，辛纳蒙是一个可能持有武器的逃犯，她刚刚杀害了继母，并向帕蒂的卧室开了一枪。

sentences.en: Why would David ask a 17-year-old to look for his daughter outside in the middle of the night instead of looking for her himself?
sentences.zh: 为什么大卫会让一个17岁的孩子在半夜去外面找他的女儿，而不是自己去找呢？

sentences.en: Some strange things had happened at
sentences.zh: 在

sentences.en: Linda's funeral, too.
sentences.zh: 琳达的葬礼上也发生了一些奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: During the service, the minister presiding over the ceremony spoke about how David and Linda's marriage was sometimes rocky.
sentences.zh: 仪式期间，主持仪式的牧师谈到大卫和琳达的婚姻有时并不和谐。

sentences.en: This prompted David to start hissing at the minister and gesturing for him to stop speaking.
sentences.zh: 这促使大卫开始对牧师发出嘘声，并示意他停止发言。

sentences.en: The minister paused the memorial and went to speak to David, before returning to the pulpit and telling the audience that he'd been mistaken.
sentences.zh: 牧师暂停了追悼会，去和大卫谈话，然后回到讲坛告诉听众他弄错了。

sentences.en: David and Linda's marriage had been almost perfect.
sentences.zh: 大卫和琳达的婚姻几乎是完美的。

sentences.en: Despite outwardly supporting
sentences.zh: 尽管表面上支持

sentences.en: Cinnamon, David hadn't attended her trial except to hear the verdict.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙，但大卫除了听取裁决外，并没有参加她的庭审。

sentences.en: At that time, he'd acted oddly, flirting with his ex-wife and
sentences.zh: 当时，他的行为很奇怪，他与前妻、

sentences.en: Cinnamon's mother, Brenda, by playfully pulling her hair.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙的母亲布伦达调情，还顽皮地拉扯她的头发。

sentences.en: He hadn't looked sombre or concerned about his daughter's fate at all.
sentences.zh: 他看起来一点也不忧郁，也不关心女儿的命运。

sentences.en: All of these strange things left
sentences.zh: 所有这些奇怪的事情让

sentences.en: Detective Jay Newell wondering if there was more to the case than met the eye.
sentences.zh: 杰伊·纽厄尔侦探怀疑这个案子远不止表面看起来那么简单。

sentences.en: In his experience, a murder of this kind within a family was usually the result of a slow build-up of grievances over a long period of time.
sentences.zh: 根据他的经验，家庭内部发生的这种谋杀案通常是长期积怨的结果。

sentences.en: But, according to Cinnamon and the other family members, Cinnamon's decision to shoot her stepmother had been impulsive, springing up almost out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 但是，根据辛纳蒙和其他家庭成员的说法，辛纳蒙射杀继母的决定是冲动的，几乎是毫无征兆地发生的。

sentences.en: Detectives had recovered diaries and other documents that Cinnamon had kept.
sentences.zh: 侦探们找回了辛纳蒙保存的日记和其他文件。

sentences.en: Nothing she had written expressed any animosity or resentment toward her stepmother.
sentences.zh: 她写的内容中没有任何对继母的敌意或怨恨。

sentences.en: They were breezy, light-hearted scribblings about pastimes and music she liked and activities she was doing with friends.
sentences.zh: 那是一些轻松、随意的涂鸦，记录了她的爱好、喜欢的音乐以及与朋友进行的活动。

sentences.en: Arthur Brown's alleged comment to his granddaughter Cinnamon only reinforced the detective's belief that Linda
sentences.zh: 亚瑟·布朗对孙女辛纳蒙所说的那番话，更加坚定了侦探的信念，即琳达·

sentences.en: Brown's murder was not the open and shut case the courts had been led to believe.
sentences.zh: 布朗的谋杀案并非法院所认为的那样是一起简单的案件。

sentences.en: Detective Newell had spoken with Arthur during the initial investigation and found him to be skittish and nervous.
sentences.zh: 纽厄尔侦探在初步调查期间曾与亚瑟谈过，发现他胆小且紧张。

sentences.en: After reports surfaced that Arthur had told Cinnamon he knew who had really killed Linda, Detective Newell decided it was time to pay him another visit.
sentences.zh: 在有报道称亚瑟告诉辛纳蒙他知道是谁真正杀害了琳达后，纽厄尔侦探决定是时候再去拜访他一次了。

sentences.en: Arthur had recently moved in with David in his new home in Anaheim Hills.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟最近搬到了大卫在阿纳海姆山的新家。

sentences.en: While David had told Cinnamon their new neighbourhood was shoddy and a downgrade from their previous home, this couldn't be further from the truth.
sentences.zh: 虽然大卫曾告诉辛纳蒙他们的新社区很破旧，比不上以前的家，但这与事实相去甚远。

sentences.en: The lavish blue-green stucco and fieldstone manor sat on a quiet, tree-lined street in the county's most exclusive neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 这座豪华的蓝绿色灰泥和毛石庄园坐落在该县最高档社区一条安静、绿树成荫的街道上。

sentences.en: It featured a large manicured lawn, a triple garage, a balcony with picturesque views and a swimming pool with a hot tub.
sentences.zh: 它拥有一个修剪整齐的大草坪、一个三车位车库、一个视野优美的阳台以及一个带热水浴缸的游泳池。

sentences.en: It was a massive upgrade from David's modest bungalow in Garden Grove.
sentences.zh: 这比大卫在花园格罗夫的简朴平房有了巨大的提升。

sentences.en: Detective Newell discovered that the
sentences.zh: 纽厄尔侦探发现，

sentences.en: Anaheim Hills house had been paid for in cash thanks to several life insurance payouts that David had received following
sentences.zh: 阿纳海姆山的房子是用现金支付的，这得益于大卫在

sentences.en: Linda's murder.
sentences.zh: 琳达被杀后获得的多笔人寿保险赔偿金。

sentences.en: He had also used the payout to purchase multiple high-end cars and fund a lavish lifestyle that included gambling trips to
sentences.zh: 他还利用这笔赔偿金购买了多辆豪车，并过上了奢华的生活，包括去

sentences.en: Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 拉斯维加斯赌博。

sentences.en: The discovery of these payouts was of particular interest to Detective Newell.
sentences.zh: 发现这些赔偿金引起了纽厄尔警探的特别关注。

sentences.en: Early in the investigation, David had told the authorities that Linda only had one small life insurance policy.
sentences.zh: 在调查初期，大卫曾告诉当局，琳达只有一份小额人寿保险。

sentences.en: It turned out that he'd actually taken out three policies, with a fourth in progress at the time that Linda was killed.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，他实际上购买了三份保险，在琳达遇害时，第四份保险也正在办理中。

sentences.en: In total, he'd collected more than $842,000 from his wife's death, the equivalent of more than $2.5 million in today's money.
sentences.zh: 他总共从妻子的死亡中获得了超过84.2万美元的赔偿，相当于今天约250多万美元的价值。

sentences.en: Detective Newell discreetly watched the property, scanning for any sign of Arthur, and more importantly, for David.
sentences.zh: 纽厄尔警探悄悄监视着这处房产，寻找亚瑟的踪迹，更重要的是，寻找大卫的踪迹。

sentences.en: He suspected the only way he could get Arthur to open up was to speak to him privately, away from the prying ears of his son.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑要让亚瑟开口的唯一办法，就是避开他儿子那双窥探的耳朵，私下与他交谈。

sentences.en: When Newell spotted Arthur in the yard and saw that David's car wasn't in the driveway, he seized the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 当纽厄尔在院子里看到亚瑟，并发现大卫的车不在车道上时，他抓住了这个机会。

sentences.en: Arthur was immediately wary of the detective's unexpected presence, though agreed to speak briefly.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟对这位警探的突然出现立刻保持警惕，但还是同意简短地聊几句。

sentences.en: Newell explained that Cinnamon had been upset by something Arthur had recently told her.
sentences.zh: 纽厄尔解释说，辛纳蒙因为亚瑟最近对她说的一些话而感到难过。

sentences.en: Arthur immediately went on the defensive, insisting he didn't know what he could have said to cause concern.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟立刻进入防御状态，坚称自己不知道说了什么会引起她的担忧。

sentences.en: Still, his affection for Cinnamon was evident as he referred to her as a darling little girl.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他对辛纳蒙的疼爱显而易见，他称她为“亲爱的小姑娘”。

sentences.en: Arthur revealed that he had only ever visited
sentences.zh: 亚瑟透露，他过去只在

sentences.en: Cinnamon when David was present, except for the one meeting four weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 大卫在场时才去探望辛纳蒙，除了四周前的那一次会面。

sentences.en: He had gone alone after Cinnamon called him, saying she wanted to talk.
sentences.zh: 那是辛纳蒙打电话给他，说想谈谈，他才独自前往的。

sentences.en: Arthur claimed that Cinnamon had simply wanted to tell him how much she loved him and that she had managed to get six months off her sentence for the good work she'd been doing.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟声称，辛纳蒙只是想告诉他她有多爱他，而且因为她表现良好，刑期已经减免了六个月。

sentences.en: Arthur told Detective Newell that the juvenile correctional facility was no place for Cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟告诉纽厄尔警探，少年管教所根本不是辛纳蒙该待的地方。

sentences.en: He then added nervously, I don't believe she had anything to do with it, and I still don't.
sentences.zh: 他随后紧张地补充道：“我不相信她与此事有关，现在也不信。”

sentences.en: I never will.
sentences.zh: “我永远都不会信。”

sentences.en: The detective asked what he had said to Cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 警探问他到底对辛纳蒙说了什么。

sentences.en: Arthur replied, I told her that I was sure I knew who planned the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟回答：“我告诉她，我确定我知道是谁策划了整件事。”

sentences.en: Newell advanced cautiously, sensing Arthur's apprehension to speak.
sentences.zh: 纽厄尔谨慎地推进话题，察觉到亚瑟对谈话的顾虑。

sentences.en: It was clear to him that the older man was genuinely frightened.
sentences.zh: 他很清楚，这位老人是真的感到害怕。

sentences.en: When Newell suggested that Cinnamon might not bear the full weight of guilt,
sentences.zh: 当纽厄尔暗示辛纳蒙可能不必承担全部罪责时，

sentences.en: Arthur nodded silently in agreement.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟默默地点头表示同意。

sentences.en: He then said,
sentences.zh: 然后他说：

sentences.en: I told Cinny that I felt like I knew who planned it, because I heard her say she was going to do something to save David.
sentences.zh: “我告诉辛妮，我觉得我知道是谁策划的，因为我听她说她要为了救大卫而做点什么。”

sentences.en: Detective Newell pressed for clarification.
sentences.zh: 纽厄尔警探追问细节。

sentences.en: Arthur went quiet and glanced anxiously over his shoulder before continuing.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟沉默下来，焦虑地回头看了一眼，然后继续说道。

sentences.en: Paddy.
sentences.zh: “帕蒂。”

sentences.en: Arthur claimed that two weeks before Linda's murder, he had been driving to a picnic with Linda,
sentences.zh: 亚瑟声称，在琳达遇害前两周，他开车带琳达、

sentences.en: David and Linda's sister, Paddy Bailey.
sentences.zh: 大卫和琳达的妹妹帕蒂·贝利去野餐。

sentences.en: During the drive,
sentences.zh: 在开车途中，

sentences.en: Linda got out of the car to use the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 琳达下车去上厕所。

sentences.en: At this point in his recounting to Detective Newell,
sentences.zh: 在向纽厄尔警探讲述到这里时，

sentences.en: Arthur spat on the ground to emphasise his disgust as he described the then 17-year-old Paddy as a, quote, foul-mouthed bitch.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟向地上吐了一口唾沫以示厌恶，他形容当时17岁的帕蒂是个“满嘴脏话的贱人”。

sentences.en: Arthur said that while Linda was away, he overheard Paddy talking about wanting to get rid of Linda in order to save David.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟说，在琳达离开时，他无意中听到帕蒂说想除掉琳达以拯救大卫。

sentences.en: Paddy allegedly claimed that Linda was plotting with her twin brother,
sentences.zh: 据称帕蒂声称琳达正在和她的孪生兄弟

sentences.en: Alan, to kill David and to take over his business.
sentences.zh: 艾伦密谋杀害大卫并夺取他的生意。

sentences.en: Arthur said it took him more than five months after the murder to recall this conversation in the car due to the shock he was experiencing at the time.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟说，由于当时受到的冲击太大，他在案发后过了五个多月才想起车里的这段对话。

sentences.en: He told Detective Newell he hadn't liked Paddy since and that he might have told Cinnamon what he'd heard, though he couldn't be certain.
sentences.zh: 他告诉纽厄尔警探，从那以后他就一直不喜欢帕蒂，而且他可能把听到的内容告诉了辛纳蒙，尽管他不能确定。

sentences.en: Still, Arthur was adamant that Cinnamon wasn't fully responsible for Linda's murder, declaring,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，亚瑟坚称辛纳蒙并非琳达遇害的全部责任人，并宣称：

sentences.en: I'd bet my life on that.
sentences.zh: “我敢拿我的命打赌。”

sentences.en: Detective Newell was left in a difficult position.
sentences.zh: 纽厄尔警探陷入了困境。

sentences.en: Arthur Brown's story would likely never hold up in court and he'd only agreed to speak with Newell on the condition that his comments remain confidential.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟·布朗的说法在法庭上可能永远站不住脚，而且他同意与纽厄尔交谈的前提是谈话内容必须保密。

sentences.en: But even if Newell couldn't act on Arthur's allegations, he still wanted to know everything about them.
sentences.zh: 但即使纽厄尔无法根据亚瑟的指控采取行动，他仍然想了解关于这些指控的一切。

sentences.en: He asked Arthur if he was fabricating the story out of dislike for Paddy.
sentences.zh: 他问亚瑟是否因为讨厌帕蒂而编造了这个故事。

sentences.en: Arthur staunchly denied this, saying he simply hoped that by confiding in Newell about the incident, it might help Cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟坚决否认，说他只是希望通过向纽厄尔吐露这件事，或许能帮到辛纳蒙。

sentences.en: At that moment, a car suddenly pulled into the driveway.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，一辆车突然开进了车道。

sentences.en: It was David Brown.
sentences.zh: 是大卫·布朗。

sentences.en: Panic flashed across Arthur's face as he muttered,
sentences.zh: 亚瑟脸上闪过一丝恐慌，他喃喃道：

sentences.en: If I stick my neck out too far,
sentences.zh: “如果我冒的险太大，

sentences.en: I'll lose my son, my granddaughter, and another granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 我会失去我的儿子、我的孙女，还有另一个孙女。”

sentences.en: Newell quickly reassured him that wouldn't happen.
sentences.zh: 纽厄尔迅速安慰他，说那不会发生。

sentences.en: All he wanted was the truth.
sentences.zh: 他想要的只是真相。

sentences.en: As David approached, Newell stuck out his hand and, thinking on his feet, introduced himself as a real estate agent named Jerry Walker.
sentences.zh: 当大卫走近时，纽厄尔伸出手，机智地介绍自己是一名名叫杰瑞·沃克的房地产经纪人。

sentences.en: Arthur stood beside him, lips pressed shut, sweat dotting his forehead.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟站在他身边，嘴唇紧闭，额头上渗出了汗珠。

sentences.en: How you doing?
sentences.zh: “你好吗？”

sentences.en: David asked casually, shaking Newell's hand.
sentences.zh: 大卫随意地问道，与纽厄尔握了握手。

sentences.en: It seemed that David didn't recognise Newell as one of the detectives who had investigated his wife's murder nearly two years earlier.
sentences.zh: 看来大卫并没有认出纽厄尔就是近两年前调查他妻子谋杀案的警探之一。

sentences.en: The three men shared a friendly conversation about property in the area before Newell quietly took his leave.
sentences.zh: 三人就该地区的房产进行了一番友好的交谈，随后纽厄尔悄然离开。

sentences.en: The allegation that Paddy Bailey had wanted her older sister dead was startling.
sentences.zh: 关于帕蒂·贝利想要她姐姐死的指控令人震惊。

sentences.en: Paddy had never told the police that she'd felt any animosity toward Linda, speaking of her only with fondness.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂从未向警方表示过她对琳达有任何敌意，提起她时总是充满感情。

sentences.en: When Paddy had been 11 years old and having troubles at home, it was Linda who had suggested that she move in with her and David until things improved or until she turned 18.
sentences.zh: 当帕蒂11岁且在家中遇到困难时，正是琳达建议她搬来和她与大卫一起住，直到情况好转或她满18岁。

sentences.en: Linda had told Paddy,
sentences.zh: 琳达曾对帕蒂说：

sentences.en: I'd love to have you.
sentences.zh: “我很乐意让你住过来。”

sentences.en: When Paddy was formally interviewed for the first time after Linda's murder, she was asked point blank, did you kill your sister?
sentences.zh: 当帕蒂在琳达遇害后第一次接受正式讯问时，她被直截了当地问到：“是你杀了你姐姐吗？”

sentences.en: Without hesitation, she replied, no, I didn't.
sentences.zh: 她毫不犹豫地回答：“不，不是我。”

sentences.en: After Cinnamon's sentencing hearing,
sentences.zh: 在辛纳蒙的量刑听证会后，

sentences.en: Detective Fred McLean ran into Cinnamon's paternal aunt,
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·麦克莱恩警探在法院停车场遇到了辛纳蒙的姑姑，

sentences.en: Susan, in the courthouse parking lot.
