sentences.en: She went outside and laid down in the doghouse with a pre-prepared suicide note gripped in her hand, just like David had told her to.
sentences.zh: 她走到外面，躺在狗屋里，手里紧紧攥着预先写好的遗书，就像大卫告诉她的那样。

sentences.en: She had no idea that the dose of pills he'd prepared was potentially lethal.
sentences.zh: 她根本不知道大卫准备的药量是足以致命的。

sentences.en: Only her body's rejection of the drugs through repeated vomiting had saved her life.
sentences.zh: 只有她身体通过反复呕吐排斥药物，才救了她一命。

sentences.en: Detectives Jay Newell and Fred McLean sat horrified as they listened to Cinnamon Brown tell her story.
sentences.zh: 侦探杰伊·纽厄尔和弗雷德·麦克莱恩听着辛纳蒙·布朗讲述她的故事，感到震惊不已。

sentences.en: While they had always suspected something more had been at play, the gravity of David's deception and callousness towards his own daughter was staggering.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们一直怀疑背后另有隐情，但大卫对亲生女儿的欺骗和冷酷程度依然令人咋舌。

sentences.en: They knew they had to expose David for the manipulative predator that he was, they just had to figure out how.
sentences.zh: 他们知道必须揭露大卫那操纵人心的掠夺者本性，只是需要想出办法。

sentences.en: After giving it some thought, they presented
sentences.zh: 经过一番思考，他们向

sentences.en: Cinnamon with a plan.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙提出了一个计划。

sentences.en: Cinnamon agreed to help.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙同意帮忙。

sentences.en: When David failed to visit her on her 18th birthday, she called him and asked him to come and see her, saying she had something urgent to discuss.
sentences.zh: 当大卫在她18岁生日时没有来看她，她打电话让他来见她，说有急事要商量。

sentences.en: David was reluctant, claiming that on top of his many ailments, he was now prone to panic attacks and simply wasn't well enough to make the trip.
sentences.zh: 大卫很不情愿，声称除了多种疾病外，他现在还容易惊恐发作，身体状况根本无法成行。

sentences.en: He pressed her to explain over the phone, but she refused.
sentences.zh: 他催促她在电话里解释，但她拒绝了。

sentences.en: In the end, he agreed to visit that coming weekend.
sentences.zh: 最后，他同意在那个周末去探视。

sentences.en: On Saturday, August 13, 1988, David drove up to the
sentences.zh: 1988年8月13日星期六，大卫开车前往

sentences.en: Youth Authority Prison in Ventura.
sentences.zh: 文图拉的青少年管理局监狱。

sentences.en: The father and daughter headed out to a small yard and sat across from each other at a picnic table beneath a pine tree.
sentences.zh: 父女俩走到一个小院子里，坐在一棵松树下的野餐桌两旁。

sentences.en: Other inmates and visitors milled about nearby, while guards kept a close watch on the scene.
sentences.zh: 附近有其他囚犯和访客走动，警卫则在密切监视现场。

sentences.en: The two made small talk for a while, before Cinnamon revealed the reason she'd requested the visit.
sentences.zh: 两人闲聊了一会儿，随后辛纳蒙透露了她要求这次探视的原因。

sentences.en: She wanted to tell authorities the truth about Linda's murder.
sentences.zh: 她想告诉当局关于琳达谋杀案的真相。

sentences.en: David desperately tried to calm his daughter.
sentences.zh: 大卫拼命试图安抚他的女儿。

sentences.en: When Cinnamon asked, what was the purpose of it all?
sentences.zh: 当辛纳蒙问，这一切到底是为了什么？

sentences.en: David offered a scattered, unsubstantiated story about Linda being deep into drugs and owing money to dangerous people.
sentences.zh: 大卫编造了一个零碎且毫无根据的故事，说琳达深陷毒瘾，还欠了危险人物的钱。

sentences.en: He said that if Cinnamon really wanted to leave prison,
sentences.zh: 他说，如果辛纳蒙真的想离开监狱，

sentences.en: Paddy would confess to the crime and take her place instead.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂会承认罪行并代替她服刑。

sentences.en: At the mention of Paddy's name, Cinnamon asked if David was really the father of Paddy's baby, which was a possibility the detectives had suggested.
sentences.zh: 提到帕蒂的名字时，辛纳蒙问大卫是否真的是帕蒂孩子的父亲，这是侦探们曾提出的可能性。

sentences.en: David evaded the question with awkward jokes before Cinnamon returned to the subject of Linda's murder.
sentences.zh: 大卫用尴尬的笑话回避了这个问题，随后辛纳蒙又回到了琳达谋杀案的话题上。

sentences.en: David cast all of the blame on Paddy, saying she was the one who'd believed Linda was plotting with her twin brother to kill him and that murdering Linda had been her idea.
sentences.zh: 大卫把所有的罪责都推给了帕蒂，说是因为帕蒂相信琳达在密谋和她的孪生兄弟一起杀他，而谋杀琳达是她的主意。

sentences.en: Paddy's the one, David said.
sentences.zh: 大卫说，帕迪才是那个主谋。

sentences.en: You and I didn't plan anything.
sentences.zh: 你和我并没有策划任何事。

sentences.en: Paddy's the one who heard it.
sentences.zh: 是帕迪听到的。

sentences.en: Paddy's the one who did it.
sentences.zh: 是帕迪干的。

sentences.en: Isn't it logical that if Paddy did it, then Paddy should be punished for it?
sentences.zh: 既然是帕迪干的，那帕迪理应受到惩罚，这难道不合逻辑吗？

sentences.en: I didn't want it to happen.
sentences.zh: 我并不想让这种事发生。

sentences.en: You should remember that.
sentences.zh: 你得记住这一点。

sentences.en: Cinnamon started crying, saying, But before that, you wanted it.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙哭了起来，说：但在此之前，你是想让它发生的。

sentences.en: No, I didn't, David replied.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有，大卫回答道。

sentences.en: I wanted to live.
sentences.zh: 我只是想活下去。

sentences.en: He claimed he was now living in fear that Paddy was going to kill him, just like she'd done to Linda.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己现在生活在恐惧中，担心帕迪会杀了他，就像她对琳达做的那样。

sentences.en: Cinnamon then brought up the pills that David had given her that night.
sentences.zh: 随后，辛纳蒙提到了那天晚上大卫给她的药片。

sentences.en: What kind of pills were those?
sentences.zh: 那是什么药？

sentences.en: She asked.
sentences.zh: 她问道。

sentences.en: Those things really had me knocked out.
sentences.zh: 那些东西真的让我昏睡过去了。

sentences.en: David replied,
sentences.zh: 大卫回答说：

sentences.en: I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Cinnamon reminded her father that he had handed her pills to take, but he deflected, stating,
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙提醒父亲，是他亲手把药交给她服用的，但他却推卸责任，说道：

sentences.en: Paddy said you didn't take what I mixed because it was too gross.
sentences.zh: 帕迪说你没吃我调配的药，因为太难喝了。

sentences.en: Without denying that he'd provided the drug cocktail, he urged Cinnamon to maintain that she couldn't remember what happened on the night of Linda's murder.
sentences.zh: 大卫没有否认他提供了药物混合物，但他极力劝说辛纳蒙坚持声称自己不记得琳达遇害当晚发生了什么。

sentences.en: David warned.
sentences.zh: 大卫警告道。

sentences.en: You can't tell the true story because everyone who knew beforehand would be imprisoned.
sentences.zh: 你不能说出真相，因为所有知情的人都会被关进监狱。

sentences.en: David promised Cinnamon that he would convince Paddy to take the blame so that Cinnamon could be released.
sentences.zh: 大卫向辛纳蒙保证，他会说服帕迪承担罪责，这样辛纳蒙就能被释放。

sentences.en: But he himself could never go to jail.
sentences.zh: 但他自己绝不能坐牢。

sentences.en: I can't survive in prison, he whined.
sentences.zh: 我在监狱里活不下去，他哀求道。

sentences.en: I would kill myself before I'd let myself die a slow and painful death in a cell.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿自杀，也不愿在牢房里慢慢地痛苦死去。

sentences.en: What David didn't realise was that his meeting with Cinnamon was being closely monitored by detectives and was entirely recorded via a wire that Cinnamon wore beneath her blouse.
sentences.zh: 大卫没有意识到的是，他与辛纳蒙的会面正受到侦探们的严密监控，并且通过辛纳蒙衬衫下佩戴的窃听器被全程录音。

sentences.en: While David had made some incriminating comments, the detectives wanted more.
sentences.zh: 虽然大卫说了一些有罪的言论，但侦探们想要更多证据。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, Cinnamon phoned her father and requested that he and Paddy both visit that day.
sentences.zh: 两周后，辛纳蒙给父亲打电话，要求他和帕迪当天一起过来。

sentences.en: David agreed and he and Paddy made the trip to Ventura.
sentences.zh: 大卫同意了，于是他和帕迪前往文图拉。

sentences.en: This time, it was two against one, as Cinnamon repeatedly asked them about Linda's murder.
sentences.zh: 这一次，变成了二对一，辛纳蒙反复追问他们关于琳达遇害的事。

sentences.en: The pair denied any knowledge of it.
sentences.zh: 两人都否认对此事知情。

sentences.en: Paddy and David also claimed not to remember many of the events Cinnamon described from the night of the crime.
sentences.zh: 帕迪和大卫还声称，对于辛纳蒙描述的案发当晚的许多细节，他们都不记得了。

sentences.en: Cinnamon asked the David why he told her to write a fake suicide note if he didn't want her to harm Linda.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙质问大卫，如果他不想让她伤害琳达，为什么要让她写一封伪造的遗书。

sentences.en: David said he had no memory of this, and neither did Paddy.
sentences.zh: 大卫说他对此毫无记忆，帕迪也一样。

sentences.en: The more David and Paddy tried to manipulate Cinnamon into thinking she was crazy or confused about what had happened, the more she stood firm in her convictions.
sentences.zh: 大卫和帕迪越是试图操纵辛纳蒙，让她觉得自己疯了或者记混了当时发生的事，她就越是坚定自己的信念。

sentences.en: Finally, towards the end of the visit, Paddy offered to take the blame.
sentences.zh: 最终，在探视快结束时，帕迪主动提出愿意承担罪责。

sentences.en: She told Cinnamon,
sentences.zh: 她告诉辛纳蒙，

sentences.en: If you didn't do it, and they've stuck you in here for what you didn't do, the least I can do is the same thing for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你没做过，而他们却把你关在这里，那我至少能为你做同样的事。

sentences.en: If you're in here for nothing, I'll go back in for nothing.
sentences.zh: 如果你是因为莫须有的罪名被关在这里，那我也愿意为了莫须有的罪名再进去。

sentences.en: Because I love you to death.
sentences.zh: 因为我爱你爱到死。

sentences.en: Although the pair didn't outwardly admit to planning Linda's murder, they did make some incriminating statements.
sentences.zh: 尽管两人表面上并未承认策划了琳达的谋杀案，但他们确实发表了一些自证其罪的言论。

sentences.en: Of particular interest were David's comments about the pills he gave to Cinnamon and his imploring of her to pretend she couldn't remember the night in question.
sentences.zh: 特别引人注目的是大卫关于他给辛纳蒙药丸的评论，以及他恳求辛纳蒙假装不记得案发当晚的事情。

sentences.en: Detectives spoke to Linda's twin brother, Alan, about the allegations made against him.
sentences.zh: 侦探们就针对他的指控与琳达的双胞胎哥哥艾伦进行了谈话。

sentences.en: Alan was surprised by the claim and insisted he had never threatened David's life, not even in jeSt.
sentences.zh: 艾伦对这一说法感到惊讶，并坚称他从未威胁过大卫的生命，甚至连开玩笑都没有。

sentences.en: He recalled that Cinnamon had once considered him her favourite uncle.
sentences.zh: 他回忆说，辛纳蒙曾经把他视为她最喜欢的叔叔。

sentences.en: But after her personality shifted around Christmas of 1984, she grew to dislike him.
sentences.zh: 但在1984年圣诞节前后，她的性格发生了转变，开始讨厌他。

sentences.en: He'd had no idea why and was unaware of just how unstable she had become.
sentences.zh: 他不知道原因，也没意识到她已经变得如此不稳定。

sentences.en: On Thursday, September 22, 1988, Detective Jay Newell led a team to David's luxurious Anaheim Hills home and arrested both David and Patty,
sentences.zh: 1988年9月22日星期四，杰伊·纽厄尔警探带领一队人马前往大卫位于阿纳海姆山的豪华住宅，逮捕了大卫和帕蒂，

sentences.en: taking them to the police station for questioning.
sentences.zh: 并将他们带到警察局接受审讯。

sentences.en: For two hours, David maintained his ignorance about Linda's murder.
sentences.zh: 在两个小时的时间里，大卫坚称自己对琳达的谋杀案一无所知。

sentences.en: He denied ever discussing the crime with Patty or Cinnamon and said he never gave his daughter drugs.
sentences.zh: 他否认曾与帕蒂或辛纳蒙讨论过这起罪行，并声称从未给过女儿毒品。

sentences.en: He also continued to deny having any romantic relationship with Patty.
sentences.zh: 他还继续否认与帕蒂有任何浪漫关系。

sentences.en: But David's web of lies began to unravel when detectives revealed they had photos of him and Patty in an embrace,
sentences.zh: 但当侦探们出示了他和帕蒂拥抱的照片，

sentences.en: as well as recordings of his conversations with Cinnamon at the prison.
sentences.zh: 以及他在监狱里与辛纳蒙谈话的录音时，大卫的谎言之网开始瓦解，

sentences.en: His demeanour shifted instantly and he immediately began spinning a new tale.
sentences.zh: 他的态度瞬间转变，并立即开始编造一个新的故事。

sentences.en: David said he was terrified of Patty and that he'd always believed she was the one who really killed Linda.
sentences.zh: 大卫说他非常害怕帕蒂，而且他一直认为真正杀害琳达的人是她。

sentences.en: He claimed the only reason he told Cinnamon to take the blame was because he was afraid of Patty and her family.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己让辛纳蒙顶罪的唯一原因，就是因为他害怕帕蒂及其家人。

sentences.en: While David had admitted that Cinnamon and Patty were convinced that Linda and her twin brother were conspiring to kill him,
sentences.zh: 尽管大卫承认辛纳蒙和帕蒂深信琳达和她的孪生兄弟密谋要杀他，

sentences.en: he insisted he never believed he never believed the two young women would really kill Linda.
sentences.zh: 但他坚称自己从没相信过这两个年轻女子真的会杀了琳达。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, 20-year-old Patty Bailey was being questioned in another room.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，20岁的帕蒂·贝利正在另一个房间接受审讯。

sentences.en: The investigators laid out the evidence piece by piece, showing her how David had used both her and Cinnamon as pawns.
sentences.zh: 调查人员逐一摆出证据，向她展示了大卫是如何把她和辛纳蒙当作棋子利用的。

sentences.en: They told her what David was saying in his interview and how he was throwing her under the bus.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉她大卫在审讯中说了些什么，以及他是如何把责任全推到她身上的。

sentences.en: For the first time, Patty began to see clearly how David had manipulated her for over a decade.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂第一次清楚地看清了大卫是如何在过去十多年里操纵她的。

sentences.en: David had entered Patty's life when she was just eight years old,
sentences.zh: 大卫是在帕蒂年仅八岁时闯入她生活的，

sentences.en: when he lived next door to the Bailey family and ingratiated himself by offering to pay the girls to clean his house.
sentences.zh: 当时他住在贝利一家隔壁，通过花钱雇佣女孩们打扫他的房子来博取好感。

sentences.en: David would have Patty sit on his lap while telling her how pretty and intelligent she was.
sentences.zh: 大卫会让帕蒂坐在他的腿上，同时告诉她她有多漂亮、多聪明。

sentences.en: Given the troubles in the Bailey home, Patty was in a vulnerable position.
sentences.zh: 鉴于贝利家里的种种问题，帕蒂当时处于一个脆弱的境地。

sentences.en: She had also been sexually abused by a close relative.
sentences.zh: 她还曾遭到过一位近亲的性虐待。

sentences.en: The positive attention from David made Patty feel special.
sentences.zh: 大卫给予的积极关注让帕蒂感到自己很特别。

sentences.en: What started as inappropriate touching by David escalated to sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 大卫起初的不当触碰行为，最终升级成了性虐待。

sentences.en: When Patty moved into the Brown household at the age of 11, David had complete access to groom and manipulate her.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂11岁搬进布朗家时，大卫完全有机会对她进行诱导和操控。

sentences.en: He convinced her that if she wanted to develop into a woman one day, she needed to perform oral sex on him.
sentences.zh: 他向她灌输，如果她想有朝一日成长为女人，就必须为他进行口交。

sentences.en: He said it was the only way she would grow up and assured her that it was entirely natural.
sentences.zh: 他说这是她长大的唯一途径，并向她保证这完全是自然现象。

sentences.en: When Patty's chest later started developing, she thought to herself,
sentences.zh: 后来当帕蒂的胸部开始发育时，她心想，

sentences.en: Hey, this guy is God.
sentences.zh: 嘿，这家伙简直是上帝。

sentences.en: By the time Patty was 15, David started raping her.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂15岁时，大卫就开始强奸她了。

sentences.en: These assaults happened during drives to school or whenever Linda was out, sleeping or in the shower.
sentences.zh: 这些侵犯发生在开车送她上学的路上，或者每当琳达出门、睡觉或洗澡的时候。

sentences.en: If Patty ever resisted, David told her a million other girls would love to take your place.
sentences.zh: 如果帕蒂反抗，大卫就会告诉她，有成千上万的女孩想取代她的位置。

sentences.en: When she outright refused, David threatened to send her back to her mother's house.
sentences.zh: 当她断然拒绝时，大卫就威胁要把她送回她母亲家。

sentences.en: He undermined Patty's sense of self by telling her,
sentences.zh: 他通过告诉帕蒂“没人会因为你是你而喜欢你”来摧毁她的自我意识。

sentences.en: No one's gonna like you for you.
sentences.zh: 没人会因为你是你而喜欢你。

sentences.en: If she did as he said and behaved the way he told her to, then people would like her.
sentences.zh: 如果她照他说的做，表现得像他要求的那样，人们才会喜欢她。

sentences.en: With nothing else to compare his behaviour to, the young girl gradually came to believe this was the way things went in every home.
sentences.zh: 由于没有其他参照物，这个小女孩逐渐认为每个家庭都是这样。

sentences.en: David promised Patty he would marry her when she was old enough, despite the fact he was already married to her older sister.
sentences.zh: 大卫向帕蒂承诺，等她长大些就娶她，尽管他当时已经和她的姐姐结婚了。

sentences.en: He had started planting seeds about killing Linda shortly after Patty had moved in with them.
sentences.zh: 早在帕蒂搬进来后不久，他就开始散布要杀掉琳达的念头。

sentences.en: The first instance was when the family was driving home from a shooting expedition in the desert and a gun was laying in Patty's lap.
sentences.zh: 第一次是在全家从沙漠射击回来开车回家的路上，当时一把枪正放在帕蒂的膝盖上。

sentences.en: They had stopped at a fast food restaurant and Linda went inside to get a drink.
sentences.zh: 他们停在一家快餐店，琳达进去买饮料。

sentences.en: It was then that David said,
sentences.zh: 就在那时，大卫说：

sentences.en: Wouldn't it be funny if the gun in your lap went off and shot Linda?
sentences.zh: 如果放在你膝盖上的枪走火打死琳达，那该多有趣啊？

sentences.en: Patty assumed he was joking, but over the years he made other similar comments, such as suggesting Patty shove Linda off a cliff.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂以为他在开玩笑，但多年来他多次发表类似言论，比如建议帕蒂把琳达推下悬崖。

sentences.en: After Cinnamon moved into the home, David started pitting Linda, Patty and Cinnamon against each other.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙搬进家后，大卫开始挑拨琳达、帕蒂和辛纳蒙之间的关系。

sentences.en: He encouraged them to vie for his attention and to turn against one another.
sentences.zh: 他鼓励她们争夺他的关注，并互相敌对。

sentences.en: While Cinnamon and Patty had initially shared a room, the real reason that Cinnamon had been forced to move from the house into a trailer wasn't because of Linda.
sentences.zh: 虽然辛纳蒙和帕蒂起初住同一个房间，但辛纳蒙被迫搬出房子住进拖车，真正原因并非琳达。

sentences.en: It was so that David could sneak into Patty's bedroom at night.
sentences.zh: 那是为了让大卫能在晚上溜进帕蒂的卧室。

sentences.en: Over time, David succeeded in convincing both Patty and Cinnamon that Linda was plotting to murder him.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，大卫成功让帕蒂和辛纳蒙都相信琳达正密谋杀害他。

sentences.en: Given that David was everything to Patty, this possibility left her distraught.
sentences.zh: 鉴于大卫是帕蒂的一切，这种可能性让她心烦意乱。

sentences.en: Initially, David attempted to convince Patty to kill Linda before Cinnamon had even moved in with them.
sentences.zh: 起初，在大卫甚至还没让辛纳蒙搬进来之前，他就试图说服帕蒂杀掉琳达。

sentences.en: One night, he woke Patty, handed her a gun, and told her to shoot a sleeping Linda at close range through a pillow.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，他叫醒帕蒂，递给她一把枪，让她隔着枕头近距离射杀熟睡中的琳达。

sentences.en: Patty went to Linda's room, but as she stood in the doorway with the gun, looking at her sleeping sister, she realised she loved her and couldn't pull the trigger.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂去了琳达的房间，但当她拿着枪站在门口，看着熟睡的姐姐时，她意识到自己爱她，无法扣动扳机。

sentences.en: Regardless, David convinced her to go along with other parts of his plan,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，大卫还是说服她配合了他计划的其他部分。

sentences.en: Patti admitted to the detectives that in July 1986, just 16 months after Linda was killed, she and David had secretly married in Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂向侦探承认，1986年7月，也就是琳达遇害仅16个月后，她和大卫在拉斯维加斯秘密结婚了。

sentences.en: At the time, he was 34 and she was 18.
sentences.zh: 当时他34岁，她18岁。

sentences.en: It was David's sixth marriage.
sentences.zh: 这是大卫的第六次婚姻。

sentences.en: They kept the true nature of their relationship a secret, not even telling David's parents, who lived in the same house.
sentences.zh: 他们对这段关系的真实性质保密，甚至连住在同一屋檐下的大卫父母都不知道。

sentences.en: When Patty became pregnant, David concocted an elaborate lie that she had met a man named Doug who had abandoned her.
sentences.zh: 当帕蒂怀孕时，大卫编造了一个复杂的谎言，说她遇到了一个叫道格的男人，对方抛弃了她。

sentences.en: This allowed David to play the role of kind benefactor, generously allowing the pregnant teenager to continue living in his home.
sentences.zh: 这让大卫扮演了仁慈恩人的角色，慷慨地允许这个怀孕的少女继续住在他的家里。

sentences.en: After their daughter was born, David refused to be named as the father on the birth certificate.
sentences.zh: 女儿出生后，大卫拒绝在出生证明上署名父亲。

sentences.en: He convinced Patty to go along with his ruse, telling her that if people knew they were together, they might judge them, or worse, suspect they played a hand in Linda's death.
sentences.zh: 他劝说帕蒂配合他的诡计，告诉她如果人们知道他们在一起，可能会评判他们，或者更糟，怀疑他们参与了琳达的死。

sentences.en: For Patty, the realisation that she'd gone along with so much, only for David to sacrifice her as readily as he'd sacrificed Cinnamon and Linda,
sentences.zh: 对帕蒂来说，意识到自己配合了这么多，结果大卫却像牺牲辛纳蒙和琳达一样轻易地牺牲了她，

sentences.en: shattered the last remnants of her loyalty.
sentences.zh: 这彻底粉碎了她最后的一点忠诚。

sentences.en: In October 1988, just a month after her arrest,
sentences.zh: 1988年10月，就在她被捕一个月后，

sentences.en: Patty Bailey made the crucial decision to confess and cooperate with authorities.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂·贝利做出了关键决定：坦白并与当局合作。

sentences.en: Her choice was influenced by multiple factors.
sentences.zh: 她的选择受到多种因素的影响。

sentences.en: David's betrayal in trying to blame her entirely for the murder, her growing understanding of how he had manipulated her throughout her life,
sentences.zh: 大卫试图将谋杀罪完全推给她，她对自己一生如何被他操纵的认识不断加深，

sentences.en: and the crushing weight of guilt over her role in her sister's death.
sentences.zh: 以及对自己参与姐姐死亡一事所感到的沉重负罪感。

sentences.en: The details she provided about events leading up to the murder and the night in question matched those Cinnamon had shared.
sentences.zh: 她提供的关于谋杀前夕及案发当晚事件的细节，与辛纳蒙所说的一致。

sentences.en: The police were elated.
sentences.zh: 警方欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: Patty's decision to break her silence was crucial in exposing the full scope of David Brown's murder plot, and both she and David were charged with first-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂打破沉默的决定对于揭露大卫·布朗谋杀阴谋的全部范围至关重要，她和大卫都被控一级谋杀罪。

sentences.en: Because Patty had been a minor when Linda was killed, she would face juvenile court.
sentences.zh: 因为帕蒂在琳达遇害时未成年，她将面临少年法庭的审判。

sentences.en: But David was looking at serving hard time.
sentences.zh: 但大卫面临的将是漫长的牢狱之灾。

sentences.en: In January 1989, nearly four years after Linda Brown's murder, the preliminary hearing for David Brown began in the Orange County Municipal Court.
sentences.zh: 1989年1月，在琳达·布朗遇害近四年后，大卫·布朗的预审在奥兰治县市政法院开始。

sentences.en: Not only would the hearing determine whether there was sufficient evidence to proceed to trial,
sentences.zh: 这次听证会不仅要确定是否有足够的证据进入审判程序，

sentences.en: it would also be the first time that both Cinnamon Brown and Patty Bailey publicly testified against him.
sentences.zh: 这也将是辛纳蒙·布朗和帕蒂·贝利首次公开出庭指证他。

sentences.en: Deputy District Attorney Jeffrey Robinson painted a picture of David Brown as a master manipulator who orchestrated his wife's murder to collect her life insurance money.
sentences.zh: 副地方检察官杰弗里·罗宾逊将大卫·布朗描绘成一个操纵大师，为了骗取人寿保险金而策划了妻子的谋杀案。

sentences.en: The hard work of Detectives Newell and McLean had revealed that David's reputation as a devoted family man was far from the truth.
sentences.zh: 纽厄尔和麦克莱恩侦探的辛勤工作揭示了大卫作为忠诚顾家男人的名声与事实相去甚远。

sentences.en: In reality, he was intimidating, charming, and adept at twisting situations to his advantage.
sentences.zh: 实际上，他擅长恐吓、魅力十足，并能熟练地扭曲局势以利于自己。

sentences.en: He also used his wealth and status to gain favour.
sentences.zh: 他还利用自己的财富和地位来博取好感。

sentences.en: David had told others that he was the black sheep of his family and that he had endured corporal punishment from a young age.
sentences.zh: 大卫曾告诉别人他是家族中的害群之马，从小就遭受体罚。

sentences.en: As a teenager, he'd developed a fixation on his health and told others that he suffered from numerous ailments.
sentences.zh: 十几岁时，他开始过度关注健康，并告诉别人他患有多种疾病。

sentences.en: His bedside drawers were full of various medications and vitamins.
sentences.zh: 他的床头抽屉里装满了各种药物和维生素。

sentences.en: He spoke of enduring everything from high blood pressure and serious gastrointestinal issues to mental health afflictions and suicidal ideation.
sentences.zh: 他谈到自己忍受着从高血压、严重的胃肠道问题到心理健康疾病和自杀念头等各种痛苦。

sentences.en: Throughout his life, he repeatedly claimed to have terminal cancer, from which he somehow always managed to recover.
sentences.zh: 在他的一生中，他多次声称自己患有绝症，但不知何故总是能康复。

sentences.en: In addition to Linda and Patty, David had been married to three other women, with his previous partners recounting episodes of controlling behaviour,
sentences.zh: 除了琳达和帕蒂，大卫还与另外三名女性结过婚，他以前的伴侣都讲述过他控制欲强的行为、

sentences.en: violent clashes, psychological abuse, sex addiction, and extramarital affairs.
sentences.zh: 暴力冲突、心理虐待、性成瘾和婚外情。

sentences.en: Of particular concern was his reported proclivity for underage girls.
sentences.zh: 特别令人担忧的是他被报道有偏爱未成年少女的倾向。

sentences.en: David sat emotionless as Deputy District Attorney Geoffrey Robinson described how he had twisted the loyalty and love of the young girls in his family to do his bidding.
sentences.zh: 当副地方检察官杰弗里·罗宾逊描述他如何扭曲家中年轻女孩的忠诚和爱来为他卖命时，大卫面无表情地坐着。

sentences.en: In contrast, David's defence attorney suggested Cinnamon and Patty were setting David up as a fall guy, attempting to shift blame for their own actions onto an innocent man.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，大卫的辩护律师暗示辛纳蒙和帕蒂是在陷害大卫，试图将自己的罪行推卸给一个无辜的人。

sentences.en: Cinnamon Brown was the first witness to take the stand.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙·布朗是第一个出庭的证人。

sentences.en: Now 18, she testified about how her father had convinced her that Linda and her brother were plotting to kill him.
sentences.zh: 现年18岁的她作证说，她的父亲是如何让她相信琳达和她的兄弟密谋杀害他的。

sentences.en: He had assured her that because of her age, she would face no real consequences if she was the one who ended Linda's life.
sentences.zh: 他向她保证，由于她的年龄，如果她亲手结束琳达的生命，她不会面临真正的后果。

sentences.en: She described her desperate need for her father's love and approval and how he had used that need to manipulate her into murder.
sentences.zh: 她描述了自己对父亲的爱和认可的渴望，以及他是如何利用这种需求操纵她去杀人的。

sentences.en: Patty Bailey testified despite not being offered immunity and knowing she could face serious consequences.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂·贝利在没有获得豁免权且知道自己可能面临严重后果的情况下出庭作证。

sentences.en: The 20-year-old described how David had sexually abused her since she was 11, grooming her with attention and gifts while isolating her from others.
sentences.zh: 这位20岁的年轻人描述了大卫如何从她11岁起就对她进行性虐待，用关注和礼物诱导她，同时将她与他人隔绝。

sentences.en: Her testimony corroborated Cinnamon's account of how David had convinced them both that Linda needed to die.
sentences.zh: 她的证词证实了辛纳蒙的说法，即大卫如何让他们俩都相信琳达必须死。

sentences.en: She revealed the careful planning that had gone into the murder,
sentences.zh: 她揭露了谋杀案背后精心的策划，

sentences.en: David's specific instructions, and how he had orchestrated the cover-up afterward.
sentences.zh: 大卫的具体指示，以及他事后如何策划掩盖真相。

sentences.en: Despite the defence's attempts to paint Cinnamon and Patty as unreliable witnesses seeking revenge, the judge found there was more than sufficient probable cause
sentences.zh: 尽管辩方试图将辛纳蒙和帕蒂描绘成寻求报复的不可靠证人，但法官认为有充分的合理理由

sentences.en: to believe David Brown had masterminded Linda's murder.
sentences.zh: 相信大卫·布朗是琳达谋杀案的幕后主使。

sentences.en: The judge ordered David bound over for trial.
sentences.zh: 法官下令将大卫移交审判。

sentences.en: As he was led from the courtroom,
sentences.zh: 当他被带出法庭时，

sentences.en: David maintained the same emotionless expression he had worn throughout the hearing.
sentences.zh: 大卫保持着他在整个听证会上一直表现出的那种面无表情。

sentences.en: While in jail awaiting trial,
sentences.zh: 在狱中等待审判期间，

sentences.en: David Brown met a fellow winmate named Richard Steinhardt.
sentences.zh: 大卫·布朗遇到了一个名叫理查德·斯坦哈特的狱友。

sentences.en: Steinhardt was a former member of an outlaw motorcycle gang who was in custody on a parole violation related to a previous cocaine conviction.
sentences.zh: 斯坦哈特曾是一个非法摩托车帮派的成员，因违反与之前可卡因定罪相关的假释规定而被拘留。

sentences.en: The two men quickly developed a rapport when David discovered that Steinhardt was a martial arts expert with a long criminal history and ties to the underworld.
sentences.zh: 当大卫发现斯坦哈特是一位拥有长期犯罪记录和地下世界联系的武术专家时，两人很快建立了融洽的关系。

sentences.en: He was also due to be released shortly.
sentences.zh: 他很快也要被释放了。

sentences.en: These factors were appealing to David as he was putting together a new plan.
sentences.zh: 这些因素对大卫很有吸引力，因为他正在制定一个新的计划。

sentences.en: Rather than face court for Linda's murder, he had decided to simply eliminate those who were trying to put him behind bars.
sentences.zh: 他决定不再为琳达的谋杀案出庭，而是简单地除掉那些试图让他入狱的人。

sentences.en: The three people David saw as the greatest threats to his freedom were Patty Bailey, Detective Jay Newell, and Deputy District Attorney Jeffrey Robinson.
sentences.zh: 大卫认为对他自由构成最大威胁的三个人是帕蒂·贝利、杰伊·纽厄尔侦探和副地方检察官杰弗里·罗宾逊。

sentences.en: He reasoned that if Newell and Robinson were out of the picture, new personnel would have to be assigned to the case.
sentences.zh: 他推断如果纽厄尔和罗宾逊出局，就必须指派新的人员来处理此案。

sentences.en: If David argued his right to a speedy trial, this would put the prosecution at a disadvantage, while getting rid of Patty meant the prosecution would lose their star witness.
sentences.zh: 如果大卫主张他享有快速审判的权利，这将使检方处于不利地位，而除掉帕蒂意味着检方将失去他们的明星证人。

sentences.en: He wasn't too worried about Cinnamon, believing that she could be discredited as unreliable and willing to do anything to get herself out of prison.
sentences.zh: 他不太担心辛纳蒙，认为她可以被抹黑为不可靠，并且为了脱罪什么都愿意做。

sentences.en: David told Richard Steinhardt that he had $500,000 buried in the desert and offered to pay him $10,000 per victim as well as $200,000 for expenses
sentences.zh: 大卫告诉理查德·斯坦哈特，他在沙漠里埋了50万美元，并提出如果他能执行这三起谋杀案，

sentences.en: if he'd carry out these three murders.
sentences.zh: 就支付他每名受害者1万美元，外加20万美元的费用。

sentences.en: David also wanted his own house and motorhome burned down to make it appear like he too was being targeted.
sentences.zh: 大卫还想烧掉自己的房子和房车，让人觉得他也是被针对的目标。

sentences.en: Steinhardt agreed.
sentences.zh: 斯坦哈特同意了。

sentences.en: He later said,
sentences.zh: 他后来这样说，

sentences.en: To prove he was serious,
sentences.zh: 为了证明他是认真的，

sentences.en: David arranged for $600 to be placed in the glove compartment of his car so that Steinhardt could purchase guns after he was released.
sentences.zh: 大卫安排在车里的手套箱里放了600美元，以便斯坦哈特出狱后可以购买枪支。

sentences.en: Steinhardt agreed that after the killings were complete, he would also help David escape from jail.
sentences.zh: 斯坦哈特同意在杀人完成后，也会帮助大卫越狱。

sentences.en: Richard Steinhardt was released in early February 1989.
sentences.zh: 理查德·斯坦哈特于1989年2月初获释。

sentences.en: David authorised his attorney to pay his brother, Tom Brown, large instalments of money which would be passed on to Steinhardt as he carried out different parts of the plot.
sentences.zh: 大卫授权他的律师向他的兄弟汤姆·布朗支付大笔款项，这些钱将在斯坦哈特执行计划的不同部分时转交给他。

sentences.en: David didn't tell Tom what the payments were for, he simply said that he needed a favour.
sentences.zh: 大卫没有告诉汤姆这些钱的用途，只是说他需要帮个忙。

sentences.en: On Monday, February 13,
sentences.zh: 2月13日星期一，

sentences.en: David phoned Steinhardt from prison.
sentences.zh: 大卫从监狱给斯坦哈特打了电话。

sentences.en: Steinhardt told him that he had killed both Geoffrey Robinson and Detective Jay Newell, stating,
sentences.zh: 斯坦哈特告诉他，他已经杀死了杰弗里·罗宾逊和杰伊·纽厄尔侦探，并说：

sentences.en: Bang bang, right in the back of the head.
sentences.zh: 砰砰，正中后脑勺。

sentences.en: David's response was simply,
sentences.zh: 大卫的回答仅仅是：

sentences.en: Alright.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: David had his brother deliver $11,000 in cash to Steinhardt within the hour.
sentences.zh: 大卫让他的兄弟在一小时内将1.1万美元现金交给了斯坦哈特。

sentences.en: Soon after,
sentences.zh: 不久之后，

sentences.en: Steinhardt told David that he had arranged for a hit woman to be arrested so that she would be placed in the same prison as Paddy.
sentences.zh: 斯坦哈特告诉大卫，他已经安排了一名女杀手被捕，这样她就会被关进和帕蒂同一个监狱。

sentences.en: She had agreed to kill Paddy in exchange for $10,000.
sentences.zh: 她已经同意以1万美元的报酬杀死帕蒂。

sentences.en: David was elated, telling Steinhardt,
sentences.zh: 大卫欣喜若狂，告诉斯坦哈特：

sentences.en: Wonderful.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: You're a good man.
sentences.zh: 你是个好人。

sentences.en: You did great.
sentences.zh: 你干得漂亮。

sentences.en: To further cement his plan,
sentences.zh: 为了进一步巩固他的计划，

sentences.en: David contacted another inmate from Paddy's prison named Sally Jacobs.
sentences.zh: 大卫联系了帕蒂监狱里的另一名囚犯，名叫萨莉·雅各布斯。

sentences.en: In the wake of Paddy's death, he offered to pay Sally if she told the authorities that Paddy had admitted to lying in her story against David.
sentences.zh: 在帕蒂死后，他提出如果萨莉告诉当局帕蒂承认在指控大卫的证词中撒了谎，就给她报酬。

sentences.en: What David didn't know was that one of his earliest conversations with Steinhardt had been overheard by a fellow prisoner
sentences.zh: 大卫不知道的是，他与斯坦哈特最早的一次谈话被一名狱友偷听到了，

sentences.en: who had gone straight to authorities with the details of the plot.
sentences.zh: 那个人直接向当局报告了阴谋的细节。

sentences.en: When they confronted Steinhardt with the information, he quickly agreed to turn informant.
sentences.zh: 当他们用这些信息与斯坦哈特对质时，他很快同意成为线人。

sentences.en: Police set up recording equipment, capturing every detail of David's murderous scheme.
sentences.zh: 警方安装了录音设备，捕捉到了大卫谋杀计划的每一个细节。

sentences.en: Between early January and early February 1989,
sentences.zh: 在1989年1月初至2月初之间，

sentences.en: investigators taped 25 to 30 phone calls between David Brown and Richard Steinhardt.
sentences.zh: 调查人员录下了大卫·布朗和理查德·斯坦哈特之间的25到30次通话。

sentences.en: The recordings revealed David discussing the planned murders of his wife and two law enforcement officials as casually as one might discuss the weather.
sentences.zh: 录音显示，大卫讨论他策划谋杀妻子和两名执法官员时，就像讨论天气一样随意。

sentences.en: Just as damning was David's use of his own brother as an unwitting accomplice.
sentences.zh: 同样令人震惊的是，大卫利用自己的兄弟作为不知情的同谋。

sentences.en: Tom Brown had no idea that he was facilitating a murder-for-hire plot when David asked him to deliver $11,000 in cash to Steinhardt.
sentences.zh: 当大卫要求汤姆·布朗将1.1万美元现金交给斯坦哈特时，汤姆根本不知道他是在协助一起雇凶杀人案。

sentences.en: He was simply doing a favour for his incarcerated brother.
sentences.zh: 他只是在帮他入狱的兄弟一个忙。

sentences.en: Upon learning the true purpose of the money he'd delivered,
sentences.zh: 在得知他送出的钱的真实目的后，

sentences.en: Tom was devastated.
sentences.zh: 汤姆崩溃了。

sentences.en: As far as I'm concerned, I don't have a brother anymore, he told investigators.
sentences.zh: “就我而言，我不再有兄弟了，”他告诉调查人员。

sentences.en: Anyone who could screw his family like this isn't part of the family.
sentences.zh: “任何能这样坑害家人的人都不配做家人。”

sentences.en: We trusted him.
sentences.zh: “我们信任他。”

sentences.en: Sally Jacobs was also an undercover police officer.
sentences.zh: 萨莉·雅各布斯也是一名卧底警察。

sentences.en: The fact that David had tried to have her claim Paddy was lying only strengthened the case against him.
sentences.zh: 大卫试图让她声称帕蒂撒谎的事实，反而加强了对他的指控。

sentences.en: Prosecutors subsequently filed several new charges against David.
sentences.zh: 检察官随后对大卫提起了几项新指控。

sentences.en: Conspiracy to commit murder, arson and perjury.
sentences.zh: 共谋谋杀、纵火和伪证罪。

sentences.en: When Paddy was told about the charges, she said, I expected something like this from him.
sentences.zh: 当帕蒂被告知这些指控时，她说：“我预料到他会做出这种事。”

sentences.en: I don't put anything past him now.
sentences.zh: “现在我对他什么都不感到意外了。”

sentences.en: As David Brown faced these new charges, attention turned to the fate of the now 21-year-old Paddy Bailey.
sentences.zh: 随着大卫·布朗面临这些新指控，人们的注意力转向了现年21岁的帕蒂·贝利的命运。

sentences.en: Her position was unique and troubling.
sentences.zh: 她的处境既独特又令人不安。

sentences.en: She was both a victim and a perpetrator, a child who had been sexually abused, groomed and manipulated.
sentences.zh: 她既是受害者又是加害者，是一个曾遭受性虐待、被诱导和操纵的孩子。

sentences.en: Yet, she had also been an active participant in the plot that led to Linda's death, even attempting to kill her sister herself before losing her nerve.
sentences.zh: 然而，她也是导致琳达死亡的阴谋的积极参与者，甚至在失去勇气之前曾试图亲手杀死姐姐。

sentences.en: Because Paddy was 17 at the time of Linda's murder and cooperated fully with prosecutors, testifying against David without any promise of immunity,
sentences.zh: 因为帕蒂在琳达遇害时只有17岁，并且与检察官充分合作，在没有任何豁免承诺的情况下指证大卫，

sentences.en: she was allowed to proceed in juvenile court.
sentences.zh: 她被允许在少年法庭受审。

sentences.en: On May 11, 1989, Paddy pleaded guilty to first-degree murder and was sentenced to four years in prison.
sentences.zh: 1989年5月11日，帕蒂承认一级谋杀罪，被判处四年监禁。

sentences.en: Despite her age at sentencing, she would serve her time in the California Youth Authority, the same facility as Cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 尽管她在判刑时已成年，但她将在加州青少年管理局服刑，也就是辛纳蒙所在的同一机构。

sentences.en: It was a stark contrast to the 27-year sentence that had been handed to Cinnamon Brown four years earlier.
sentences.zh: 这与四年前辛纳蒙·布朗被判处的27年刑期形成了鲜明对比。

sentences.en: The difference lay not just in their relative culpability, but in timing.
sentences.zh: 区别不仅在于她们各自的罪责，还在于时机。

sentences.en: Paddy's testimony had helped to break the case that would finally bring David Brown to justice.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂的证词有助于破解此案，最终将大卫·布朗绳之以法。

sentences.en: For Paddy, the sentence marked both an end and a beginning.
sentences.zh: 对帕蒂来说，这个判决既是一个终点，也是一个起点。

sentences.en: Although she would remain in custody until she was 25, she had broken free from David Brown's influence.
sentences.zh: 虽然她将继续服刑直到25岁，但她已经摆脱了大卫·布朗的影响。

sentences.en: Paddy would have four years to come to terms with everything that had happened, to understand how thoroughly David had twisted her perception of normal family life
sentences.zh: 帕蒂将有四年的时间来消化所发生的一切，去理解大卫是如何彻底扭曲她对正常家庭生活的认知的，

sentences.en: and to prepare for whatever life might hold when she emerged.
sentences.zh: 并为她出狱后可能面临的任何生活做好准备。

sentences.en: While incarcerated, Paddy truly began to grapple with what had happened to Linda and the role she played in her death.
sentences.zh: 在服刑期间，帕蒂真正开始面对琳达的遭遇以及她在琳达之死中所扮演的角色。

sentences.en: As described in the book,
sentences.zh: 正如斯蒂芬·辛格勒、蒂姆·希尔和丹妮尔·希尔在《家庭谋杀案》一书中所述，

sentences.en: A Killing in the Family by Stephen Singular and Tim and Danielle Hill,
sentences.zh: 《家庭谋杀案》一书由斯蒂芬·辛格勒、蒂姆·希尔和丹妮尔·希尔合著，

sentences.en: Paddy spoke to visitors about her deep regret and pain and her desire to somehow go back in time and change what had happened.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂在与访客交谈时，表达了她深深的悔恨和痛苦，以及想要时光倒流、改变所发生之事的渴望。

sentences.en: If I'd have said something, none of this would have happened, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说：“如果我当时说了什么，这一切都不会发生。”

sentences.en: I could have told a teacher at school or told Linda even before I moved in that David was doing funny things.
sentences.zh: “我本可以告诉学校的老师，或者在搬进去之前就告诉琳达，大卫在做些奇怪的事情。”

sentences.en: If I talk about Linda in therapy and to deal with her death,
sentences.zh: “如果我在心理治疗中谈论琳达，去面对她的死亡，

sentences.en: I'll start to forget about her.
sentences.zh: 我就开始忘记她了。”

sentences.en: I don't want to do that, so I won't.
sentences.zh: “我不想那样，所以我不会谈。”

sentences.en: I just don't want to forget her.
sentences.zh: “我只是不想忘记她。”

sentences.en: I took my sister's life.
sentences.zh: “我夺走了我继母的生命。”

sentences.en: I'm out here on this pretty day.
sentences.zh: “我在这美好的一天里重获自由。”

sentences.en: And she's not.
sentences.zh: “而她却不在了。”

sentences.en: David Brown's trial began in the Orange County Superior Court in spring of 1990.
sentences.zh: 大卫·布朗的审判于1990年春在奥兰治县高等法院开始。

sentences.en: The prosecution's case was built on the recorded conversations between David and Cinnamon, testimony from Cinnamon and Paddy, and recordings and testimony by Richard Steinhardt
sentences.zh: 检方的案件建立在大卫与辛纳蒙的录音对话、辛纳蒙与帕蒂的证词，以及理查德·斯坦哈特提供的录音和证词之上，

sentences.en: about David's subsequent attempt to have witnesses killed.
sentences.zh: 内容涉及大卫随后试图雇凶杀害证人的企图。

sentences.en: They painted a picture of a man driven by greed and control.
sentences.zh: 他们描绘了一个被贪婪和控制欲驱使的男人形象。

sentences.en: The defence called very few witnesses and David didn't testify at all.
sentences.zh: 辩方传唤的证人寥寥无几，大卫本人则完全没有出庭作证。

sentences.en: Throughout the trial, he maintained the same emotionless demeanour that had characterised his behaviour since Linda's death.
sentences.zh: 在整个审判过程中，他始终保持着自琳达去世以来那种毫无表情的冷漠态度。

sentences.en: During closing arguments,
sentences.zh: 在结案陈词中，

sentences.en: Deputy District Attorney Jeffrey Robertson heaped scorn on David, calling him a classical sociopathic personality and a poor excuse for a human being.
sentences.zh: 副地方检察官杰弗里·罗伯逊对大卫极尽嘲讽，称他为典型的反社会人格，是个根本算不上人的人渣。

sentences.en: On June 15, 1990, after less than seven hours of deliberation, the jury returned with their verdict.
sentences.zh: 1990年6月15日，在经过不到七小时的审议后，陪审团做出了裁决。

sentences.en: David Brown was found guilty of first-degree murder with special circumstances for financial gain and conspiracy to commit murder.
sentences.zh: 大卫·布朗被判一级谋杀罪成立，并伴有经济利益等特殊情节，同时还被判犯有谋杀共谋罪。

sentences.en: At his sentencing hearing the following month, the judge told David,
sentences.zh: 在次月的量刑听证会上，法官对大卫说，

sentences.en: He sentenced David to life in prison without the possibility of parole.
sentences.zh: 他判处大卫终身监禁，不得假释。

sentences.en: Cinnamon and Paddy both heard the verdict while incarcerated at California Youth Authority.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙和帕蒂在加州青年管理局服刑时听到了这一判决。

sentences.en: After learning of David's fate, they found each other, sat down together, and cried.
sentences.zh: 得知大卫的下场后，她们找到了彼此，坐在一起痛哭流涕。

sentences.en: Linda Brown was just 23 years old when she died.
sentences.zh: 琳达·布朗去世时年仅23岁。

sentences.en: The tragedy of her murder rippled through multiple lives, a young woman dead, her infant daughter left without a mother, a 14-year-old girl manipulated into killing her stepmother,
sentences.zh: 她被谋杀的悲剧波及了许多人的生命：一位年轻女性的死亡，她留下的幼女失去了母亲，一个14岁的女孩被操纵去杀害继母，

sentences.en: and an 11-year-old child groomed and sexually abused before being drawn into her own sister's murder.
sentences.zh: 还有一个11岁的孩子在被卷入她亲姐姐的谋杀案之前，曾遭受过诱导和性虐待。

sentences.en: The case inspired two books, both published in 1991.
sentences.zh: 此案激发了两本书的创作，均于1991年出版。

sentences.en: As well as A Killing in the Family, there was true crime author Anne Rules, If You Really Loved Me.
sentences.zh: 除了《家庭谋杀案》，还有真实犯罪作家安·鲁尔的《如果你真的爱我》。

sentences.en: NBC aired a four-hour miniseries titled Love, Lies and Murder based on Rules' book.
sentences.zh: NBC根据鲁尔的书播出了名为《爱、谎言与谋杀》的四小时迷你剧。

sentences.en: The dramatisation of the tragic story brought national attention to the case and in 1992, after serving seven years of her 27-year sentence,
sentences.zh: 这部悲剧故事的戏剧化改编引起了全国对该案的关注，1992年，在服完了27年刑期中的7年后，

sentences.en: Cinnamon Brown was paroled at the age of 21.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙·布朗在21岁时获得假释。

sentences.en: After her release,
sentences.zh: 在她获释后，

sentences.en: Assistant District Attorney
sentences.zh: 助理地方检察官

sentences.en: Geoffrey Robinson remarked,
sentences.zh: 杰弗里·罗伯逊评论道：

sentences.en: The real story is the courage of this kid who was abandoned by her family.
sentences.zh: “真正的故事是这个被家庭抛弃的孩子所展现出的勇气。”

sentences.en: A 14-year-old kid who was completely brainwashed for a number of years by her father, who herself has been the victim of terrible crimes and has now paid her debt to society,
sentences.zh: “一个14岁的孩子，被她父亲彻底洗脑了多年，她自己也是可怕罪行的受害者，现在她已经偿还了对社会的债务，

sentences.en: maybe even more of a debt than she should have.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能偿还的比她应付的还要多。”

sentences.en: Robinson acknowledged the challenges that lay ahead for Cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 罗伯逊承认辛纳蒙未来将面临挑战。

sentences.en: Her battle would be a very, very tough one because her case is of such a high profile, a girl who has been earmarked as a killer for the rest of her life.
sentences.zh: “她的抗争将会非常、非常艰难，因为她的案子备受瞩目，她是一个余生都被贴上杀人犯标签的女孩。”

sentences.en: Cinnamon's first-ever television interview was on The Oprah Winfrey Show.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙的首次电视采访是在《奥普拉·温弗瑞秀》上进行的。

sentences.en: Sitting across from Oprah,
sentences.zh: 坐在奥普拉对面，

sentences.en: Cinnamon looked like a deer in the headlights as she struggled to answer questions and describe how her father had manipulated her into killing Linda.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙看起来像受惊的小鹿，她努力回答问题，描述她父亲是如何操纵她去杀害琳达的。

sentences.en: The power that David still held over her emotions was evident.
sentences.zh: 大卫对她情感的掌控力依然显而易见。

sentences.en: He's always gonna be my father and I love him, she said.
sentences.zh: “他永远是我的父亲，我爱他。”她说。

sentences.en: David Brown unsuccessfully appealed his conviction and on March 22, 2014, after more than two decades in prison, he died of natural causes at the age of 61.
sentences.zh: 大卫·布朗对定罪的上诉未果，2014年3月22日，在入狱二十多年后，他因自然原因去世，享年61岁。

sentences.en: He passed away without ever expressing remorse for his crimes.
sentences.zh: 他去世时从未对自己的罪行表示过悔意。

sentences.en: David and Linda's infant daughter,
sentences.zh: 大卫和琳达的幼女，

sentences.en: Ashley, was raised by her paternal grandmother and has no memory of ever meeting her father, despite seeing him regularly until the age of five.
sentences.zh: 阿什利，由她的祖母抚养长大，尽管五岁前经常见到父亲，但她对父亲毫无记忆。

sentences.en: As a young child,
sentences.zh: 小时候，

sentences.en: Ashley was told that her mother was killed in a car accident, only to later learn that Linda had actually been murdered.
sentences.zh: 阿什利被告知母亲死于车祸，后来才得知琳达实际上是被谋杀的。

sentences.en: Initially,
sentences.zh: 起初，

sentences.en: Ashley was told that her father had been framed by her older half-sister,
sentences.zh: 阿什利被告知她的父亲是被她同父异母的姐姐，

sentences.en: Cinnamon, until some friends helped her uncover the truth by finding a book about the case at a library.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙陷害的，直到一些朋友在图书馆找到一本关于此案的书，帮她揭开了真相。

sentences.en: Today,
sentences.zh: 如今，

sentences.en: Ashley is married with the children of her own.
sentences.zh: 阿什利已经结婚并有了自己的孩子。

sentences.en: She has spoken about how hard it was growing up without a mother and how her kids can't have the quintessential grandmother who loves and spoils them the way other children do.
sentences.zh: 她曾谈到在没有母亲的情况下长大是多么困难，以及她的孩子们无法像其他孩子那样，拥有一个疼爱和宠溺他们的典型祖母。

sentences.en: After Patty Bailey was released at the age of 25, she changed her name and eventually remarried, fighting for and winning custody of the daughter she shared with David.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂·贝利在25岁获释后，改了名字并最终再婚，她争取并赢得了与大卫所生女儿的监护权。

sentences.en: She attempted to reconnect with Cinnamon after their releases, but Cinnamon declined, saying she wasn't ready and needed to focus on re-entering society.
sentences.zh: 她曾试图在获释后与辛纳蒙重新建立联系，但辛纳蒙拒绝了，称她还没准备好，需要专注于重新融入社会。

sentences.en: Cinnamon found work in the travel industry and married in 1994.
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙在旅游业找到了工作，并于1994年结婚。

sentences.en: She expressed deep remorse for Linda's murder.
sentences.zh: 她对琳达的谋杀案表达了深深的悔意。

sentences.en: Despite Linda's young age, she had cared for Cinnamon like a mother, even standing up for her and defending her when David put her down.
sentences.zh: 尽管琳达年纪轻轻，但她像母亲一样照顾辛纳蒙，甚至在大卫贬低辛纳蒙时站出来维护她。

sentences.en: Speaking to Anne Rule for her book If You Really Loved Me,
sentences.zh: 在接受安·鲁尔采访，谈及她的书《如果你真的爱我》时，

sentences.en: Cinnamon said,
sentences.zh: 辛纳蒙说：

sentences.en: I feel very ashamed of what I did to Linda.
sentences.zh: “我对伤害琳达的行为感到非常羞愧。”

sentences.en: It's very painful knowing I took her life and she'll never have a chance again.
sentences.zh: “知道我夺走了她的生命，而她再也没有机会了，这非常痛苦。”

sentences.en: I cry and pray for her often because I loved her.
sentences.zh: “我经常为她哭泣和祈祷，因为我爱她。”

sentences.en: That's what hurts more than anything.
sentences.zh: “这比什么都让我心痛。”

sentences.en: I loved her and still believed my father's lies and I killed her.
sentences.zh: “我爱她，却依然相信父亲的谎言，并杀害了她。”

sentences.en: If there was one wish given to me and it could be anything
sentences.zh: “如果我能有一个愿望，无论是什么，

sentences.en: I'd wish Linda her life back.
sentences.zh: 我希望琳达能活过来。”
